security.translationZh: 工作安全感或稳定性是第二重要的职业目标（工作与生活的平衡位居第一），其次是致力于某项事业的使命感或为社会福祉做贡献的满足感。
security.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

security.sentenceEn: You meet new people every day: the grocery worker, the cab driver, new people at work or the security guard at the door.
security.translationZh: 你每天都会遇到新朋友：杂货店店员、出租车司机、工作中认识的新同事，或是门口的保安。
security.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

security.sentenceEn: they have to step up security measures.

source.sentenceEn: Every day, scientists, technologists and engineers are discovering new ways to exploit renewable energy sources and develop techniques not just to use power more intelligently but to power our intelligence.
source.translationZh: 每天，科学家、技术专家和工程师都在探索利用可再生能源的新方法，并开发相关技术——不仅是为了更智能地使用能源，也是为了用能源驱动我们的智能发展。
source.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

source.sentenceEn: Tipping has always been a vital source of income for workers in historically tipped services, like restaurants, where the tipped minimum wage can be as low as US$2.13 an hour.
source.translationZh: 小费一直是传统小费服务行业工作者的重要收入来源，例如餐厅，这些行业的小费最低工资标准可低至每小时2.13美元。
source.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

source.sentenceEn: These should be available to them as part of their cultural heritage and history and as a source of national pride.
source.translationZh: 这些文物理应作为他们文化遗产和历史的一部分，以及民族自豪感的源泉，供他们接触和了解。
source.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

source.sentenceEn: We tend to think that friends and family members are our biggest sources of connection, laughter, and warmth.
source.translationZh: 我们往往认为朋友和家人是我们获取情感联结、欢声笑语和温暖关怀的最大来源。
source.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

source.sentenceEn: At night, scan the horizon for artificial light sources , such as fires and streetlights, then walk toward the glow of light pollution.
source.translationZh: 夜晚时分，扫视地平线寻找人工光源，如篝火和路灯，然后朝着光污染形成的光亮处走去。
source.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

source.sentenceEn: AI replaces the boring parts of your job. If you're doing research, you can have AI go out and look for relevant sources and information that otherwise you just wouldn't have time for.
source.translationZh: 人工智能可以取代工作中枯燥乏味的部分。如果你正在做研究，人工智能可以帮你查找相关的资料和信息，而这些工作要是你自己做的话根本没时间完成。

species.sentenceEn: "This is a really, really critical issue for restoration in Southeast Asia, because many of the most important timber species and tree species — the ones that will lock up the most carbon — they're all masting species ."
species.translationZh: 对于东南亚的生态修复工作而言，这是一个极其关键的问题。因为许多最重要的木材物种和树种——也就是那些固碳能力最强的树种——全部都属于‘大年结实’物种。
species.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

species.sentenceEn: Christopher Kettle, Biodiversity International's director for forest genetic resources and restoration in Rome, says that the need for infrastructure — things such as mechanisms for collecting and storing seeds, and nurseries to raise seedlings — might be most desperate here because many trees are 'masting' species , which don't produce seeds every year.
species.translationZh: 位于罗马的国际生物多样性中心森林遗传资源与修复主管克里斯托弗·凯特尔表示，这里对基础设施（如种子采集和储存机制，以及培育幼苗的苗圃）的需求最为迫切，因为许多树木属于“大年结实”物种，并不会每年都产种。
species.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

species.sentenceEn: Climate change is also expected to alter relationships between trees, insects, diseases and other forest species .
species.translationZh: 预计气候变化还将改变树木、昆虫、疾病以及其他森林物种之间的关系。
species.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

species.sentenceEn: Asia is arguably the region most neglected by global efforts to increase diversity in restoration and to study native species .
species.translationZh: 亚洲可以说是在提高恢复多样性和研究本土物种的全球努力中，最被忽视的地区。
species.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

species.sentenceEn: "If you don't look at the soil at the start, you can spend a lot of money and time putting in species that aren't going to survive there."
species.translationZh: 如果你不从一开始就检查土壤情况，那么投入大量金钱和时间去种植那些无法在该地存活的物种，最终只会付诸东流。
species.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

species.sentenceEn: Global heating is benefiting some species but others are too isolated to find suitable new habitat, and gardening habits—paving over gardens and using pesticides—aren't helping either.
species.translationZh: 全球变暖对某些物种有利，但另一些物种因过于孤立而无法找到合适的新栖息地，而园艺习惯——将花园铺上硬路面和使用杀虫剂——也无济于事。

structure.sentenceEn: In 1967 a scientific survey of the Peloponnesian coast was gathering data to analyze changes in sea levels when British oceanographer Nicholas Flemming first spotted the sunken structures .
structure.translationZh: 1967年，一项针对伯罗奔尼撒半岛海岸的科学调查正在收集数据以分析海平面变化，此时英国海洋学家尼古拉斯·弗莱明首次发现了这些沉没的建筑物。
structure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

structure.sentenceEn: Their well-developed hippocampal structures may enable elephants, like rats and people, to construct cognitive maps.
structure.translationZh: 它们发达的海马体结构或许能让大象像老鼠和人类一样构建认知地图。
structure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

structure.sentenceEn: As a result, these structures became important centres for cultural exchange and interaction, with travellers sharing their cultures, ideas and beliefs, as well as taking knowledge with them, greatly influencing the development of several civilisations.
structure.translationZh: 因此，这些建筑成为了文化交流与互动的重要中心。旅行者们在此分享各自的文化、思想和信仰，同时也带走知识，这对多个文明的发展产生了深远影响。
structure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

structure.sentenceEn: For example, a high growth rate placed great strains on the existing structures of governance, of administration, and above all of socialization.
structure.translationZh: 例如，高增长率给现有的治理结构、行政结构，尤其是社会化结构带来了巨大压力。
structure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

structure.sentenceEn: Fundamentally, the USPS is in a historic squeeze between technological change that has permanently decreased demand for its bread-and-butter product, first-class mail, and a regulatory structure that denies management the flexibility to adjust its operations to the new reality.
structure.translationZh: 从根本上讲，美国邮政署正处于历史性的双重挤压之中：一方面是技术变革永久性地降低了对其核心产品——一类邮件的需求，另一方面是监管结构剥夺了管理层调整业务以适应新现实的灵活性。
structure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

structure.sentenceEn: Rather, we ascribe meanings to texts on the basis of interaction between what we might call textual and contextual material: between kinds of organization or patterning we perceive in a text's formal structures (so especially its language structures ) and various kinds of background, social knowledge, belief and attitude that we bring to the text.
structure.translationZh: 相反，我们赋予文本意义是基于我们所谓的文本材料与语境材料之间的互动：一方面是我们在文本形式结构（尤其是语言结构）中感知到的各种组织方式或模式，另一方面是我们带入文本的各种背景知识、社会认知、信念和态度。

struggle.sentenceEn: Standing in the shoes of others fine tunes our social understanding, useful as we struggle to understand friends, neighbours, customers and co-workers.
struggle.translationZh: 设身处地为他人着想能让我们微调自己的社交理解力，这在我们努力理解朋友、邻居、客户和同事时非常有用。

struggle.sentenceEn: There is an overall decline in visits and many are struggling as local authorities come under continued financial pressure.
struggle.translationZh: 随着地方政府持续面临财政压力，总访问量正呈现全面下降的趋势，许多机构也正陷入困境。
struggle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

struggle.sentenceEn: Ever since taking on Netflix Inc. at its own game, old Hollywood has struggled to turn a profit in streaming, with the likes of Disney+, Peacock and Paramount+ losing billions of dollars each year, sparking concerns that the services will never be as profitable as cable once was.
struggle.translationZh: 自从开始与网飞公司(Netflix Inc.)在其主场展开竞争以来，传统好莱坞在流媒体业务上一直难以实现盈利。迪士尼+、孔雀(Peacock)和派拉蒙+等平台每年亏损数十亿美元，这引发了人们的担忧：这些流媒体服务可能永远无法像有线电视曾经那样盈利。
struggle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

struggle.sentenceEn: This clash highlights an ongoing struggle between the organic, user-driven evolution of public spaces and the desire for a visually curated and controlled urban environment.
struggle.translationZh: 这场冲突凸显了公共空间自发的、用户驱动的演变与打造视觉上精心策划和受控制的城市环境的愿望之间持续存在的矛盾。
struggle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

struggle.sentenceEn: If you struggle with low self-esteem, you might find it especially difficult to reach out for help because you have the added worry of the other person declining your request.
struggle.translationZh: 如果你饱受自卑困扰，可能会发现求助格外困难，因为你还会额外担心对方拒绝你的请求。
struggle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

struggle.sentenceEn: Hom said similar registration requirements could benefit struggling cities and towns, but "if we want to make a change in the housing market, the main one is we have to build a lot more."
struggle.translationZh: 霍姆表示，类似的注册要求可能会对处境艰难的城镇有所帮助，但“如果我们想改变住房市场，关键是我们必须建造更多的住房。”
struggle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

shift.sentenceEn: Tracing the history of the term, we can see how the definition of scientific literacy has shifted over time, muddying the waters when it comes to determining the goals of science education.
shift.translationZh: 追溯该术语的历史可以发现，科学素养的定义随着时间的推移发生了变化，这使得在确定科学教育的目标时，情况变得更加复杂且模糊不清。
shift.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

shift.sentenceEn: By instilling best practices in AI engagement and creating policies that evolve with the technology, businesses can positively shift the AI landscape.
shift.translationZh: 通过逐步建立AI互动的最佳实践，并制定随技术演进的政策，企业能够积极地改变人工智能领域的格局。
shift.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

shift.sentenceEn: This abrupt shift to an "intensive mothering narrative", which suggests that mothers should manage childcare alone, was likely to have been harmful.
shift.translationZh: 这种突然转向“密集型母亲叙事”的转变——即暗示母亲应独自承担育儿责任——很可能具有危害性。
shift.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

shift.sentenceEn: During the 1840s and 1850s, in the early days of photography, exposure times were notoriously long: the daguerreotype photographic method (producing an image on a silvered copper plate) could take several minutes to complete, resulting in blurred images as sitters shifted position or adjusted their limbs.
shift.translationZh: 在19世纪40至50年代，也就是摄影术发展的早期，曝光时间出奇地长：银版照相法（在镀银铜板上成像）可能需要几分钟才能完成，这导致被拍摄者稍微变换姿势或调整肢体就会使影像模糊。
shift.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

shift.sentenceEn: "It's as if you're driving a stick shift ," says Judith Hall, a psychologist at Northeastern University, "and if you start thinking about it too much, you can't remember what you're doing. But if you go on automatic pilot, you're fine. Much of our social life is like that."
shift.translationZh: 美国东北大学心理学家朱迪思·霍尔说：“这就好比你在开手动挡汽车，如果你开始想得太多，反而会忘了自己在做什么。但如果你进入自动驾驶状态，就会开得很顺畅。我们的社交生活大多也是如此。”
shift.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

shift.sentenceEn: It is human nature to shift between self-doubt and blind pride.
shift.translationZh: 在自我怀疑与盲目骄傲之间摇摆不定，这是人之常情。
shift.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）

status.sentenceEn: You might see such refusals as implying something negative about the status of your relationship with them.
status.translationZh: 你可能会把这种拒绝视为暗示你与他们的关系状况存在某种负面问题。
status.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

status.sentenceEn: His status in Lord Wellington's headquarters and the recognition given to him for his work were all bound up with the class politics of the army at the time.
status.translationZh: 他在威灵顿勋爵总部的地位以及因其工作所获得的认可，都与当时军队中的阶级政治紧密相连。
status.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

status.sentenceEn: Other scientists perform the specialised work of peer review also for free, because it is a central element in the acquisition of status and the production of scientific knowledge.
status.translationZh: 其他科学家也免费从事专业的同行评审工作，因为这是获取学术地位和产出科学知识的核心要素。
status.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

status.sentenceEn: In some ways the scientific publishing model resembles the economy of the social internet: labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status , while huge profits are made by a few big firms who run the market places.
status.translationZh: 在某些方面，科学出版模式与社交互联网经济颇为相似：人们免费提供劳动，以换取获得地位的希望，而少数运营着市场平台的大公司却赚取了巨额利润。
status.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

status.sentenceEn: And interest groups ranging from postal unions to greeting-card makers exert self-interested pressure on the USPS's ultimate overseer – Congress – insisting that whatever else happens to the Postal Service, aspects of the status quo they depend on get protected.
status.translationZh: 而从邮政工会到贺卡制造商的各类利益集团则对美国邮政局的最终监管机构——国会——施加着利己压力，坚称无论邮政局发生何种变故，他们所依赖的现状中的某些方面都必须得到保护。
status.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

status.sentenceEn: Its founders sought to raise the status of artists.
status.translationZh: 该中心的创始人旨在提高艺术家的地位。

specific.sentenceEn: There are many different types of automatic door, with each relying on specific signals to tell them when to open.
specific.translationZh: 自动门有许多不同类型，每种类型都依靠特定信号来判断何时开启。
specific.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

specific.sentenceEn: The scientific community measures the quality of those papers in a number of ways, including the perceived quality of the journal (as reflected by the title's impact factor) and the number of citations a specific paper accumulates.
specific.translationZh: 科学界通过多种方式衡量这些论文的质量，包括期刊的公认质量（体现在该刊的影响因子上）以及特定论文积累的引用次数。
specific.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

specific.sentenceEn: For example, AI can be used to analyse what type of advertising content or copy would be appropriate to "speak" to a specific target customer group by revealing information about trends and preferences through the analysis of big data.
specific.translationZh: 例如，人工智能可以通过大数据分析揭示有关趋势和偏好的信息，从而分析出何种类型的广告内容或文案适合与特定目标客户群体进行“沟通”。
specific.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

specific.sentenceEn: These journals can act as milk cows where every single article in an issue may cite a specific paper or a series of papers.
specific.translationZh: 这些期刊可能会充当"摇钱树"的角色，一期中的每一篇文章都可能引用某一篇特定论文或一系列论文。
specific.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

specific.sentenceEn: In this age of generalists, it pays to have specific knowledge or skills.
specific.translationZh: 在这个通才当道的时代，拥有特定的知识或技能是很有价值的。
specific.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

specific.sentenceEn: Students who stand out in a specific extracurricular activity will be favored by top-tier institutions.
specific.translationZh: 在特定课外活动中表现突出的学生将受到顶尖院校的青睐。

strategy.sentenceEn: Much more important are the places we live, work and socialise—yet there is no clear cross-government strategy for improving these social determinants of health.
strategy.translationZh: 更为重要的是我们生活、工作和社交的场所——然而，目前并没有明确的跨政府战略来改善这些健康的社会决定因素。
strategy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

strategy.sentenceEn: Worse, when policies like the national obesity strategy are scrapped, taxpayers are left with the heavy price tag of treating the illnesses, like diabetes, that result.
strategy.translationZh: 更糟糕的是，当国家肥胖战略这类政策被取消后，纳税人最终要为治疗由此引发的糖尿病等疾病支付高昂费用。
strategy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

strategy.sentenceEn: Yet despite two decades of strategies and a number of major health reforms, we have failed to make meaningful progress on any of these aims.
strategy.translationZh: 然而，尽管二十年来我们制定了各种策略并实施了多项重大医疗改革，但在实现这些目标方面我们并未取得实质性进展。
strategy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

strategy.sentenceEn: While productive tree planting can deliver real financial benefits to rural economies and contribute to the UK's net-zero strategy , the focus of government support continues to be on food production and the rewilding and planting of native woodland solely for biodiversity.
strategy.translationZh: 虽然生产性植树能够为农村经济带来实实在在的经济效益，并有助于英国实现净零战略目标，但政府的支持重点仍然放在粮食生产以及仅以生物多样性为目的的荒野恢复和本土林地种植上。
strategy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

strategy.sentenceEn: Ed Home, of the RHS, said: "We launched our sustainability strategy last year and fake grass is just not in line with our ethos and views on plastic. We recommend using real grass because of its environmental benefits, which include supporting wildlife, alleviating flooding and cooling the environment."
strategy.translationZh: 英国皇家园艺学会的埃德·霍姆表示：“我们去年启动了可持续发展战略，而人造草坪不符合我们的理念以及对塑料的立场。我们建议使用天然草坪，因为它具有诸多环境益处，包括支持野生动物生存、缓解洪涝灾害以及降低环境温度。”
strategy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

strategy.sentenceEn: Give priority to pursuing its net-zero strategy .

supreme.sentenceEn: All this was put at great risk late last month, when the U.S. Supreme Court issued a ruling in an Idaho case that provides the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) far less authority to regulate wetlands and waterways.
supreme.translationZh: 然而，所有这一切在上个月末陷入了巨大的危机——美国最高法院就爱达荷州的一起案件作出裁决，大幅削弱了美国环境保护局(EPA)对湿地和水道的监管权。
supreme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

supreme.sentenceEn: But Judge Patricia Millett rightly argued in a concurring opinion that "the result is unhinged from the realities of modern broadband service," and said Congress or the Supreme Court could intervene to "avoid trapping Internet regulation in technological anachronism."
supreme.translationZh: 但帕特里夏·米利特法官在其协同意见中正确指出，"这一结果脱离了现代宽带服务的实际情况"，并表示国会或最高法院可进行干预，以"避免将互联网监管困在技术时代错误之中"。
supreme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

supreme.sentenceEn: On Tuesday, the appeals court unanimously upheld the 2017 order deregulating broadband providers, citing a Supreme Court ruling from 2005 that upheld a similarly deregulatory move.
supreme.translationZh: 周二，上诉法院一致维持了2017年那份放松宽带提供商监管的命令，并援引了最高法院2005年的一项裁决，该裁决同样支持了放松监管的举措。
supreme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

supreme.sentenceEn: The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an "important" policy interest.
supreme.translationZh: 美国最高法院对基于性别的分类持反对态度，除非这些分类是为了实现某项“重大”政策利益。
supreme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

supreme.sentenceEn: Who are most likely to welcome the Supreme Court ruling?
supreme.translationZh: 谁最有可能欢迎最高法院的这项裁决？

supreme.sentenceEn: It is welcomed by the Supreme Court.
supreme.translationZh: 最高法院对此表示欢迎。

solution.sentenceEn: As a librarian whose day job revolves around special collections and digital assets, I share the night terrors of historians, and I'd be lying if I said a comprehensive preservation solution currently exists.
solution.translationZh: 作为一名日常工作围绕特藏文献和数字资产展开的图书馆员，我与历史学家们有着同样的梦魇。如果说目前存在一个全面的保存解决方案，那我一定是在撒谎。

solution.sentenceEn: They pool resources, collaborate, think outside the box, and find solutions and ways around obstacles to explore science for the sake of science without the traditional boundaries of working inside a formal setting.

solution.sentenceEn: Everyone wants to be that person—the one who looks at the same information as everyone else, but who sees a fresh, innovative solution .

signal.sentenceEn: This perspective makes sense if you simplify the workings of a complex brain, reducing it to an array of electrical pulses; cells in plants also communicate through electrical signals .

signal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

signal.sentenceEn: Though plants lack brains, the firing of electrical signals in their stems and leaves nonetheless triggered responses that hinted at consciousness, researchers previously reported.
signal.translationZh: 研究人员此前曾报告称，尽管植物没有大脑，但其茎和叶中电信号的传递仍会引发暗示意识存在的反应。
signal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

signal.sentenceEn: Surveys show that younger generations are more concerned about climate change, and some of the success of plant-based meat can be chalked up to shoppers wanting to signal their desire to protect the environment.

series.translationZh: 去年是著名风景摄影师威廉·亨利·杰克逊一系列黄石公园摄影作品的150周年纪念。

series.sentenceEn: These were some of the words that Nature readers used to describe their experience of art-science collaborations in a series of articles on partnerships between artists and researchers.
series.translationZh: 这些是《自然》杂志读者在一系列关于艺术家与研究人员合作的文章中，用来描述他们参与艺术与科学合作体验的部分词汇。
series.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

series.sentenceEn: In one series of studies, researchers instructed Chicago-area commuters using public transportation to strike up a conversation with someone near them.
series.translationZh: 在一系列研究中，研究人员指示芝加哥地区乘坐公共交通的通勤者与身边的人攀谈。
series.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

staff.sentenceEn: Say your boss picks holes in your sales report, and you come away feeling like this means she thinks you're a poor member of staff .
staff.translationZh: 假设你的老板对你的销售报告百般挑剔，你离开时觉得这意味着她认为你是个表现不佳的员工。
staff.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

staff.sentenceEn: Big-name PRH authors may suffer a bit, but it's those mid-list authors, who normally rely on Waterstones staff 's passion for promoting books by lesser-known writers, who will be praying for an end to the dispute.
staff.translationZh: 企鹅兰登书屋的知名作家可能会受到些许影响，但真正盼望这场争端结束的，是那些中游作家——他们通常依赖水石书店员工对推广小众作家作品的热情。
staff.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

staff.sentenceEn: The publishing industry talks about diversity in terms of authors and staff but it also needs a plurality of ways of delivering intellectual contact, choice and different voices.
staff.translationZh: 出版业在谈论作者和员工的多样性，但它也需要多种方式来实现知识交流、提供选择和展现不同声音。
staff.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

staff.sentenceEn: And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong.
staff.translationZh: 而且企业会降低员工薪酬，因为企业要承担雇佣安排出现问题时的风险。
staff.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

staff.sentenceEn: Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff .
staff.translationZh: 由于就业保护法增加了解雇员工的成本，雇主在招聘新员工时会更加谨慎。
staff.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

staff.sentenceEn: Waterstones staff hesitate to promote big-name authors' books.
staff.translationZh: 水石书店员工不愿推广知名作家的书籍。

scale.sentenceEn: This year, we've been forced to scale back the footprint of the fest.
scale.translationZh: 今年，我们被迫缩小了活动的规模。
scale.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

scale.sentenceEn: I was shocked to learn recently that some scientists want to scale back their research in an effort to decrease carbon emissions.
scale.translationZh: 最近得知一些科学家为了减少碳排放而打算缩减研究规模，我感到十分震惊。
scale.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

scale.sentenceEn: As for me, weighing myself every day caused me to shift my focus from being generally healthy and physically active, to focusing solely on the scale .
scale.translationZh: 就我而言，每天称重让我把关注点从保持整体健康和积极运动转移到了只盯着体重秤上的数字。
scale.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

scale.sentenceEn: Rather than obsessing over the scale , turn your focus to how you look, feel, how your clothes fit and your overall energy level.
scale.translationZh: 与其纠结于体重秤上的数字，不如将注意力转向你的外观、感受、衣物的合身程度以及整体的精力水平。
scale.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

scale.sentenceEn: I had gained weight in the form of muscle mass, but thinking only of lowering the number on the scale , I altered my training program.
scale.translationZh: 我的体重确实增加了，但这是肌肉量增加的结果。然而，我一心只想着降低体重秤上的数字，于是调整了训练计划。
scale.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

scale.sentenceEn: We're also giving our customers better channels versus picking up the phone to accomplish something beyond human scale .
scale.translationZh: 我们也在为客户提供更优质的渠道，让他们不必再通过打电话来完成那些超出人力范围的事情。

sector.sentenceEn: A more immediate response is to broaden our digital imaginations to conceive of AI technologies that don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities in the sectors that different parts of the country care most about, like health care, education, and manufacturing.
sector.translationZh: 一个更直接的应对措施是拓宽我们的数字想象力，以构想那些不只是简单取代工作岗位，而是能在全国不同地区最关注的行业（如医疗保健、教育和制造业）中拓展机会的人工智能技术。
sector.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

sector.sentenceEn: Improving living standards and increasing prosperity for more people will require greater use of digital technologies to boost productivity in various sectors , including health care and construction, says Coyle.
sector.translationZh: 科伊尔表示，要提高更多人的生活水平并增进繁荣，就需要更多地利用数字技术来提高包括医疗保健和建筑业在内的各个行业的生产力。
sector.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

sector.sentenceEn: Pat Hardy, who sympathises with the views of the energy sector , is resisting proposed changes to science standards for pre-teen pupils.
sector.translationZh: 帕特·哈迪（Pat Hardy）对能源行业的观点持同情态度，她正抵制针对青春期前学生科学课程标准的拟议修改。
sector.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

sector.sentenceEn: Requiring companies to make gender the primary qualification for board membership will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards.
sector.translationZh: 要求公司将性别作为董事会成员的首要任职资格，将不可避免地导致私营部门董事会成员的经验水平下降。
sector.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

sector.sentenceEn: It is hard to get right, and requires a remarkable degree of vision, as well as cooperation between city authorities, the private sector , community groups and cultural organisations.
sector.translationZh: 要做到恰到好处并非易事，这需要非凡的远见卓识，以及城市当局、私营部门、社区团体和文化组织之间的通力合作。
sector.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

sector.sentenceEn: The English language teaching sector directly earns nearly ￡1.3 billion for the UK in invisible exports and our other education related exports earn up to ￡10 billion a year more.
sector.translationZh: 英语语言教学行业通过无形出口为英国直接创收近13亿英镑，而我们其他与教育相关的出口每年更能带来高达100亿英镑的收入。
sector.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

secure.sentenceEn: Goodall added: "While food production and biodiversity health are clearly of critical importance, we need our land to also provide secure supplies of wood for construction, manufacturing and contribute to net zero."
secure.translationZh: 古德尔补充道：“虽然粮食生产和生物多样性健康显然至关重要，但我们也需要土地能够提供稳定的木材供应，用于建筑、制造业并助力实现净零目标。”
secure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

secure.sentenceEn: By cutting out the middlemen, the farmers secure more profit for their produce.
secure.translationZh: 通过省去中间商环节，农民们能为自己的农产品获得更多利润。
secure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

secure.sentenceEn: Education was no longer a secure route of social mobility.
secure.translationZh: 教育不再是实现社会流动的可靠途径。
secure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

secure.sentenceEn: Among the most popular ways they are doing this, the company said, is by reducing their overall expenses, securing life insurance or maximizing their contributions to retirement accounts.
secure.translationZh: 该公司表示，他们最常用的方式包括削减总体开支、购买人寿保险或最大限度地增加对退休账户的供款。
secure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

secure.sentenceEn: With the content of papers secured for free, the publisher needs only find a market for its journal.
secure.translationZh: 论文内容已免费获取，出版商只需为其期刊寻找市场即可。
secure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

secure.sentenceEn: The idea is to force social scientists to integrate their work with other categories, including health and demographic change; food security; marine research and the bio-economy; clean, efficient energy; and inclusive, innovative and secure societies.
secure.translationZh: 其目的是促使社会科学家将其研究工作与其他领域相结合，包括健康与人口变化、粮食安全、海洋研究与生物经济、清洁高效能源以及包容、创新和安全的社会。

spot.sentenceEn: In 1967 a scientific survey of the Peloponnesian coast was gathering data to analyze changes in sea levels when British oceanographer Nicholas Flemming first spotted the sunken structures.
spot.translationZh: 1967年，一项针对伯罗奔尼撒半岛海岸的科学调查正在收集数据以分析海平面变化，此时英国海洋学家尼古拉斯·弗莱明首次发现了这些沉没的建筑物。
spot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

spot.sentenceEn: When we look at a face or a picture, our eyes pause on one spot at a time, often on the eyes or mouth.
spot.translationZh: 当我们注视一张脸或一幅图片时，眼睛会一次在一个点上停留，通常是在眼睛或嘴巴部位。
spot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

spot.sentenceEn: These pauses typically occur at about three per second, and the eyes then jump to another spot , until several important points in the image are registered like a series of snapshots.
spot.translationZh: 这些注视停顿通常每秒约三次，随后眼睛会跳转到另一个位置，直到图像中的几个重要点像一系列快照一样被记录下来。
spot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

spot.sentenceEn: For example, even in dense forest, you should be able to spot gaps in the tree line due to roads, train tracks, and other paths people carve through the woods.
spot.translationZh: 例如，即便在茂密的森林中，你也应该能发现林线中的空隙，这些空隙是由道路、铁轨以及人们在树林中开辟的其他小径造成的。
spot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

spot.sentenceEn: The hot spots and their volcanic trails are milestones that mark the passage of the plates.
spot.translationZh: 这些热点及其火山轨迹是标记板块移动的里程碑。
spot.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
spot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

spot.sentenceEn: Cobe is designed to see just the biggest structures, but astronomers would like to see much smaller hot spots as well, the seeds of local objects like clusters and superclusters of galaxies.
spot.translationZh: 宇宙背景探测器（Cobe）的设计初衷是观测这些最大的结构，但天文学家们同样希望能看到小得多的热点区域——即那些形成星系团和超星系团等局部天体的“种子”。
spot.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
spot.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

survive.sentenceEn: Looking at these DNA sequences, we get a biological testimony to the environment these animals lived in and the experiences they survived .
survive.translationZh: 通过观察这些 DNA 序列，我们可以看到这些动物所处环境及其生存经历在生物学上留下的印记。
survive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

survive.sentenceEn: "If you don't look at the soil at the start, you can spend a lot of money and time putting in species that aren't going to survive there."
survive.translationZh: 如果你不从一开始就检查土壤情况，那么投入大量金钱和时间去种植那些无法在该地存活的物种，最终只会付诸东流。
survive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

survive.sentenceEn: At the time of creation, no attempts were made at intentional preservation, yet analog materials have a chance of surviving and serving as the historical record that biographers, historians, and novelists rely on.
survive.translationZh: 在创作之时，人们并未刻意进行保存，但这些模拟材料却有可能幸存下来，成为传记作者、历史学家和小说家所依赖的历史记录。
survive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

survive.sentenceEn: For millennia, we've known what we've known due to artifacts that have survived , often despite their original creators' neglect.
survive.translationZh: 数千年来，我们所了解的知识往往源于那些历经岁月留存下来的文物，尽管它们的原创造者可能早已将其遗忘。
survive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

survive.sentenceEn: To realize how great was the dramatic activity, we must remember further that hosts of plays have been lost, and that probably there is no author of note whose entire work has survived .
survive.translationZh: 要理解当时戏剧活动的繁荣程度，我们还必须记住：大量剧本已然散佚，而任何一位知名剧作家的作品恐怕都未能完整留存。
survive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

survive.sentenceEn: During their six- to twelve-week voyage, they survived on barely enough food allotted to them.
survive.translationZh: 在六到十二周的航程中，他们仅靠配给的勉强够量的食物维持生命。
survive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

selection.sentenceEn: A recent paper, titled "The Natural Selection of Bad Science", published on the Royal Society's open science website, attempts to answer this intriguing and important question.
selection.translationZh: 最近，一篇题为《不良科学的自然选择》的论文发表在英国皇家学会的开放科学网站上，试图回答这个有趣而重要的问题。
selection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

selection.sentenceEn: A young man can decide on a likely spouse on his own and then ask his parents to arrange the marriage negotiations, or the young man's parents may make the choice of a spouse, giving the child little to say in the selection .
selection.translationZh: 年轻男子可以自己选定心仪的配偶，再请父母安排提亲事宜；或者，也可能由男方父母为其选定配偶，在这个过程中，孩子几乎没有发言权。
selection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

selection.sentenceEn: Just as the bewildering variety of human courtship rituals might all be considered forms of sexual selection , perhaps the world's languages, music, social and religious customs and even history are governed by universal features.
selection.translationZh: 正如人类纷繁复杂的求偶仪式都可被视为性选择的表现形式一样，或许世界上的语言、音乐、社会及宗教习俗乃至历史，都受到某些普遍特征的制约。
selection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

selection.sentenceEn: In 1968, the Congress of the United States passed the Jury Selection and Service Act, ushering in a new era of democratic reforms for the jury.
selection.translationZh: 1968年，美国国会通过了《陪审团遴选与服务法案》，开创了陪审团民主改革的新时代。
selection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

selection.sentenceEn: But as recently as in 1968, jury selection procedures conflicted with these democratic ideals.
selection.translationZh: 但就在1968年，陪审团遴选程序仍与这些民主理想相冲突。
selection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

selection.sentenceEn: Natural selection hardly works among the rich and the poor.
selection.translationZh: 自然选择在富人与穷人之间几乎不起作用。
selection.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）

severe.sentenceEn: Research shows that these prescribed burns make subsequent wildfires less severe , even if later fires happen under the most dangerous weather conditions.
severe.translationZh: 研究表明，这种计划烧除可以降低后续野火的严重程度，即使火灾发生在最危险的天气条件下也是如此。
severe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

severe.sentenceEn: The fact that fires happened so often meant they couldn't have been severe enough to kill most trees.
severe.translationZh: 火灾发生得如此频繁，这一事实意味着它们当时的烈度不足以烧死大多数树木。
severe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

severe.sentenceEn: "It's a double-edged sword because wildfires are getting more severe and larger under climate change and we need this work even more, but then the work gets more challenging," said Susan Prichard, a fire ecologist at the University of Washington.
severe.translationZh: 华盛顿大学的火灾生态学家苏珊·普里查德表示：“这是一把双刃剑，因为在气候变化的影响下，野火正变得愈发严重且规模更大，我们比以往任何时候都更需要这项工作，但与此同时，工作的开展也变得更具挑战性。”
severe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

severe.sentenceEn: This is why the recent severe delays caused by numerous maintenance works have thrown the rail industry into chaos at a time when most people head on holiday, which matters for business in a country where tourism accounts for 10 percent of GDP.
severe.translationZh: 近期，频繁的维护工程导致了严重的延误。时值大众休假出行的高峰期，这使得铁路行业陷入混乱。对于旅游业贡献了10%国内生产总值的国家而言，这直接影响到了国家的经济。
severe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

severe.sentenceEn: And stay alert to serious symptoms, such as chest pain or pressure, severe shortness of breath or dizziness, or faintness, and seek medical attention immediately.
severe.translationZh: 同时要警惕严重症状，如胸痛或胸部压迫感、严重呼吸急促、头晕或晕厥，一旦出现应立即就医。
severe.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

severe.sentenceEn: It may make severe fires harder to put out.
severe.translationZh: 这可能会导致严重火灾更难扑灭。

shortage.sentenceEn: The moves are the most significant change to building regulations in years, and industry experts say they will inevitably lead to higher prices at a time when a shortage of materials and high labour costs are already driving up bills.
shortage.translationZh: 这些举措是近年来建筑法规最重大的变革，行业专家表示，在目前材料短缺和劳动力成本高企已在推高建筑费用的情况下，新规将不可避免地导致价格进一步上涨。
shortage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

shortage.sentenceEn: In the medical field, to take an obvious example, the pandemic meant that there were still clear shortages of doctors, nurses and other medical personnel.
shortage.translationZh: 举一个明显的例子，在医疗领域，疫情意味着医生、护士和其他医疗人员仍然存在明显短缺。
shortage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

shortage.sentenceEn: As of May, those rates had spiked up to 13.3 per cent and 13.7 per cent, and although many worker shortages had disappeared, not all had done so.
shortage.translationZh: 截至5月，两国失业率已分别飙升至13.3%和13.7%，尽管许多劳动力短缺问题已不复存在，但并非所有短缺都已缓解。
shortage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

shortage.sentenceEn: In February, at 3.5 per cent and 5.5 per cent respectively, unemployment rates in Canada and the United States were at generational lows and worker shortages were everywhere.
shortage.translationZh: 2月份，加拿大和美国的失业率分别为3.5%和5.5%，处于世代最低水平，劳动力短缺现象随处可见。
shortage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

shortage.sentenceEn: American farmers have been complaining of labor shortages for several years.
shortage.translationZh: 多年来，美国农民一直在抱怨劳动力短缺问题。
shortage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

shortage.sentenceEn: Which of the following causes the shortage of wood supply in the UK?
shortage.translationZh: 以下哪项导致了英国木材供应短缺？

switch.sentenceEn: This is not to say that there is no point in getting a degree, but rather stress that a degree is not for everyone, that the switch from classroom to lecture hall is not an inevitable one and that other options are available.
switch.translationZh: 这并不是说获得学位毫无意义，而是要强调学位并非适合所有人，从中学课堂到大学讲堂的转变并非必然之路，而且还有其他选择可供考虑。
switch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

switch.sentenceEn: "They bought the seedlings and closed them down," complained Paul Arnold, a partner at San Francisco-based Switch Ventures, putting an end to businesses that might one day turn into competitors.
switch.translationZh: 总部位于旧金山的Switch Ventures合伙人保罗·阿诺德抱怨道：“他们买下这些幼苗企业，然后就把它们扼杀了”，终止了那些有朝一日可能成为竞争对手的企业。
switch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

switch.sentenceEn: But switching to a mainly plant-based diet wouldn't help.
switch.translationZh: 但是转向以植物为主的饮食也无济于事。
switch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

switch.sentenceEn: For these reasons, I stopped weighing myself every day and switched to a bimonthly weighing schedule instead.
switch.translationZh: 出于这些原因，我不再每天称体重，而是改成了每两周称一次的计划。
switch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

switch.sentenceEn: When our brains switch between being focused and unfocused on a task, they tend to be more efficient.
switch.translationZh: 当我们的大脑在专注和不专注于某项任务之间切换时，往往会变得更加高效。
switch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

switch.sentenceEn: Many students find themselves listing one major on their college applications, but switching to another after taking college classes.
switch.translationZh: 许多学生在大学申请时填写了某个专业，但在上过大学课程后却转到了另一个专业。
switch.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

solve.sentenceEn: But demonstrating the efficacy of science will be crucial if we are to solve humanity's greatest challenges.

solve.sentenceEn: Remember that in light of whatever the problem the old system solved —or, maybe, has failed to solve in recent memory—it was a great idea at the time.

solve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

solve.sentenceEn: As long as there are other cars on the roads, self-driving cars won't solve the problems of crashes, said Dugan.

solve.sentenceEn: For a long time, scientists and policy makers concentrated on the idea that teenagers were a problem that needed to be solved .

solve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

solve.sentenceEn: Fluid intelligence is the type of intelligence that has to do with short-term memory and the ability to think quickly, logically, and abstractly in order to solve new problems.
solve.translationZh: 流体智力是一种与短期记忆相关的智力类型，指的是为解决新问题而进行快速、逻辑和抽象思考的能力。

solve.sentenceEn: Mental health is the source of creativity for solving problems, resolving conflict, making our surroundings more beautiful, managing our home life, or coming up with a creative business idea or invention to make our lives easier.

scholar.sentenceEn: Board members like her "casually dismiss the career work of scholars and scientists as just another misguided opinion," says Dan Quinn, senior communications strategist at the Texas Freedom Network, a non-profit group that monitors public education.

scholar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

scholar.sentenceEn: High growth rates increased the chances for academic innovation; they also weakened the forms and processes by which teachers and students are admitted into a community of scholars during periods of stability or slow growth.
scholar.translationZh: 高增长率增加了学术创新的机会；但同时也削弱了在稳定或缓慢增长时期教师和学生融入学术共同体的形式与流程。
scholar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

scholar.sentenceEn: These new forms were at first mainly written by scholars and performed by amateurs, but in England, as everywhere else in western Europe, the growth of a class of professional actors was threatening to make the drama popular, whether it should be new or old, classical or medieval, literary or farcical.
scholar.translationZh: 这些新形式最初主要由学者创作，由业余爱好者表演，但在英国，如同西欧其他各地一样，职业演员阶层的兴起正推动戏剧走向大众化，无论其是新是旧、古典还是中世纪、文学性还是滑稽性。
scholar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

scholar.sentenceEn: Among the commission's 51 members are top-tier-university presidents, scholars , lawyers, judges, and business executives, as well as prominent figures from diplomacy, filmmaking, music and journalism.
scholar.translationZh: 该委员会的51名成员包括顶尖大学校长、学者、律师、法官、企业高管，以及外交、电影制作、音乐和新闻领域的知名人士。
scholar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

scholar.sentenceEn: To encourage innovation and competition, the report calls for increased investment in research, the crafting of coherent curricula that improve students' ability to solve problems and communicate effectively in the 21st century, increased funding for teachers and the encouragement of scholars to bring their learning to bear on the great challenges of the day.
scholar.translationZh: 为鼓励创新与竞争，该报告呼吁加大研究投入，精心设计连贯的课程体系以提升学生在21世纪解决问题和有效沟通的能力，增加教师经费投入，并鼓励学者将所学知识应用于应对当今重大挑战。
scholar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

scholar.sentenceEn: The legal issues in the case are obscure: whereas the Supreme Court has ruled that states do have some regulatory authority over nuclear power, legal scholars say that Vermont case will offer a precedent-setting test of how far those powers extend.
scholar.translationZh: 此案涉及的法律问题晦涩复杂：尽管最高法院已裁定各州确实对核能拥有一定的监管权，但法律学者表示，佛蒙特州这起案件将成为一个开创先例的测试，检验这些权力究竟能延伸到何种程度。

slave.sentenceEn: This slim volume is packed with tips to help wage slaves as well as lottery winners get the most "happiness bang for your buck."

slave.sentenceEn: Washington, who had begun to believe that all men were created equal after observing the bravery of the black soldiers during the Revolutionary War, overcame the strong opposition of his relatives to grant his slaves their freedom in his will.

slave.translationZh: 尽管如此，杰斐逊还是解放了海明斯的孩子们——但并未解放海明斯本人以及他约150名其他奴隶。

slave.sentenceEn: Once in office, Jefferson extended slavery with the Louisiana Purchase in 1803; the new land was carved into 13 states, including three slave states.

strengthen.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

strengthen.sentenceEn: Strengthening economic growth, at the same time as winter grips the northern hemisphere, could push the price higher still in the short term.

software.sentenceEn: Some AI software can analyze and optimize marketing email subject lines to increase open rates.
software.translationZh: 一些人工智能软件能够分析和优化营销邮件的主题行，以提高邮件的打开率。

software.sentenceEn: One company in the UK, Phrasee, claims their software can outperform humans by up to 10 percent when it comes to email open rates.

software.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

software.sentenceEn: If software promises to save lives on the scale that drugs now can, big data may be expected to behave as a big pharma has done.
software.translationZh: 如果软件有望像现在的药物一样大规模拯救生命，那么大数据的表现可能会与大型制药公司如出一辙。
software.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

stable.sentenceEn: His distinctive style is now one of the most commonly used prompts in the new open-source AI art generator Stable Diffusion.

stable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

stable.sentenceEn: Karla Ortiz, an illustrator based in San Francisco who found her work in Stable Diffusion's data set, has been raising awareness about the issues around AI art and copyright.

slavery.sentenceEn: Once in office, Jefferson extended slavery with the Louisiana Purchase in 1803; the new land was carved into 13 states, including three slave states.

slavery.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

strength.sentenceEn: FaceTime with a relative as you strength train or stretch at home.
strength.translationZh: 在家进行力量训练或拉伸时，可以和亲戚进行FaceTime视频通话。

strength.sentenceEn: The most immediate changes will be observed in skill level, strength and inches lost.
strength.translationZh: 最立即可见的变化将体现在技能水平、力量和腰围尺寸的减小上。
strength.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

strength.sentenceEn: If left to themselves, such trends will diminish the relative strength of the English language in international education markets as the demand for educational resources in languages, such as Spanish, Arabic or Mandarin grows and international business process outsourcing in other languages such as Japanese, French and German, spreads.
strength.translationZh: 如果任其发展，随着西班牙语、阿拉伯语或汉语普通话等语言的教育资源需求不断增长，以及日语、法语和德语等其他语言的国际业务流程外包不断扩展，这些趋势将削弱英语在国际教育市场的相对优势。
strength.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

strength.sentenceEn: Most importantly, it constantly modifies and enhances the games you play to build on the strengths you are developing – much like a(n) effective exercise routine requires you to increase resistance and vary your muscle use.

strength.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

strength.sentenceEn: I believe it is precisely this permanent coexistence of metaphysical message through physical means that is the strength of music.
strength.translationZh: 我认为，正是这种通过物质手段传递形而上学信息的永恒共存，构成了音乐的力量。
strength.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

supporter.sentenceEn: However, supporters of fake grass point out that there is also an environmental impact with natural lawns, which need mowing and therefore usually consume electricity or petrol.
supporter.translationZh: 然而，人造草坪的支持者指出，天然草坪也会对环境产生影响，因为它们需要修剪，因此通常会消耗电力或汽油。
supporter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

supporter.sentenceEn: Any writer needs to read as much and as widely as they can; it's the one indispensable supporter —something you can't do without.
supporter.translationZh: 任何作家都需要尽可能多地广泛阅读；阅读是不可或缺的支撑——是写作过程中万万不能缺少的要素。
supporter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

supporter.sentenceEn: Elected leaders must be allowed to help supporters deal with bureaucratic problems without fear of prosecution for bribery.
supporter.translationZh: 民选领导人应当能够在不担心被以受贿罪起诉的情况下，帮助支持者处理官僚体制相关问题。
supporter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

supporter.sentenceEn: In Wisconsin the unions have rallied thousands of supporters against Scott Walker, the hardline Republican governor.
supporter.translationZh: 在威斯康星州，工会集结了数千名支持者反对强硬派共和党州长斯科特·沃克。
supporter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

supporter.sentenceEn: Supporters of the new supersystems argue that these mergers will allow for substantial cost reductions and better coordinated service.
supporter.translationZh: 新超级铁路系统的支持者认为，这些合并将大幅降低成本，并实现更协调的服务。

supporter.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

supporter.sentenceEn: Supporters of the theory viewed culture as a collection of integrated parts that work together to keep a society functioning.
supporter.translationZh: 该理论的支持者将文化视为相互整合的各个部分的集合，这些部分共同作用以维持社会的正常运转。
supporter.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）

suspect.sentenceEn: Schwitzgebel suspects the greatest impact came from social influence—classmates or teaching assistants leading the discussions may have shared their own vegetarianism, showing it as achievable or more common.
suspect.translationZh: 施维茨格贝尔认为，影响主要来自社会层面——主持讨论的同学或助教可能分享了自己的素食主义生活方式，让大家觉得素食不仅可行，还相当普遍。
suspect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

suspect.sentenceEn: Ambady suspected that deliberation focused them on vivid but misleading cues, such as certain gestures or utterances, rather than letting the complex interplay of subtle signals form a holistic impression.
suspect.translationZh: 安巴迪猜测，深思熟虑使参与者将注意力集中在那些鲜明但具有误导性的线索上，比如某些手势或话语，而未能让微妙信号间的复杂相互作用形成一个整体印象。
suspect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

suspect.sentenceEn: California has asked the justices to refrain from a sweeping ruling, particularly one that upsets the old assumption that authorities may search through the possessions of suspects at the time of their arrest.
suspect.translationZh: 加利福尼亚州已请求大法官们避免做出影响深远的裁决，尤其是不要推翻执法机关在逮捕嫌疑人时可以搜查其财物这一长期存在的假设。
suspect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

suspect.sentenceEn: They should start by discarding California's lame argument that exploring the contents of a smartphone – a vast storehouse of digital information – is similar to, say, going through a suspect's purse.
suspect.translationZh: 他们首先应当驳斥加利福尼亚州毫无说服力的论点，即查看智能手机（一个庞大的数字信息库）的内容类似于搜查嫌疑人的钱包。
suspect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

suspect.sentenceEn: In theory, the success of an applicant should not depend on the few others chosen randomly for interview during the same day, but Dr Simonsohn suspected the truth was otherwise.
suspect.translationZh: 理论上，申请者能否成功不应取决于同一天随机选中参加面试的其他几名申请者，但西蒙松博士怀疑实际情况并非如此。
suspect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

suspect.sentenceEn: We have to suspect that continuing economic growth promotes the development of education even when governments don't force it.
suspect.translationZh: 我们不得不猜想，即便政府不强制推行教育，持续的经济增长也会促进教育的发展。
suspect.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
suspect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

sympathy.sentenceEn: Karen R. Sime: While animals in captivity deserve sympathy , zoos play a significant role in starting young people down the path of related sciences.
sympathy.translationZh: 卡伦·R·赛姆：虽然圈养动物值得同情，但动物园在引导年轻人踏上相关科学道路方面发挥着重要作用。
sympathy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

sympathy.sentenceEn: In a number of studies, Malti and others have shown that guilt and sympathy may represent different pathways to cooperation and sharing.
sympathy.translationZh: 在多项研究中，马尔蒂等人发现内疚感和同情心可能代表着通往合作与分享的不同路径。
sympathy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

sympathy.sentenceEn: And vice versa: High sympathy can substitute for low guilt.
sympathy.translationZh: 反之亦然：高共情能力可以弥补低愧疚感的不足。
sympathy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

sympathy.sentenceEn: Using caregiver assessments and the children's self-observations, she rated each child's overall sympathy level and his or her tendency to feel negative emotions after moral transgressions.
sympathy.translationZh: 她通过照料者的评估和孩子们的自我观察，对每个孩子的整体同情心水平以及在道德失范行为后产生负面情绪的倾向进行了评分。
sympathy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

sympathy.sentenceEn: Some kids who are low in sympathy may make up for that shortfall by experiencing more guilt, which can rein in their nastier impulses.
sympathy.translationZh: 一些缺乏同情心的孩子可能会通过体验更多内疚感来弥补这一不足，这种内疚感可以抑制他们更恶劣的冲动。
sympathy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

sympathy.sentenceEn: While animals in captivity deserve sympathy , zoos play a significant role in starting young people down the path of related sciences.
sympathy.translationZh: 虽然圈养动物值得同情，但动物园在引导年轻人走上相关科学道路方面发挥着重要作用。

setting.sentenceEn: They pool resources, collaborate, think outside the box, and find solutions and ways around obstacles to explore science for the sake of science without the traditional boundaries of working inside a formal setting .
setting.translationZh: 他们汇聚资源、通力协作、跳出思维定式，在不受正式工作环境传统界限束缚的情况下，为了科学而探索科学，寻找解决问题的方法并克服各种障碍。
setting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

setting.sentenceEn: An infant born to a hunter-gatherer society could have more than ten caregivers—this contrasts starkly to nursery settings in the UK where regulations call for a ratio of one carer to four children aged two to three.
setting.translationZh: 一个出生在狩猎采集社会的婴儿可能有十多位照料者——这与英国托儿所的情况形成鲜明对比，英国的规定要求2至3岁儿童的照料比例为1:4。
setting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

setting.sentenceEn: Primary care providers have their hands full and may not be able to follow through with patients who have trouble driving because they can't turn their heads or remember where they are going—or have gotten shorter and haven't changed their seat settings sufficiently to reach car pedals easily.
setting.translationZh: 初级保健提供者已经忙得不可开交，可能无法跟进那些驾驶有困难的患者——这些患者要么无法转动头部，要么记不住要去哪里，要么因身形变矮而未能充分调整座椅设置，导致无法轻松够到汽车踏板。
setting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

setting.sentenceEn: It's common to have a "cubicle mate" or special confidant in a work setting .
setting.translationZh: 在工作环境中，有一位“隔间伙伴”或特别的知己是很常见的。
setting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

setting.sentenceEn: In some settings , red sneakers or dress T-shirts can convey status; in others not so much.
setting.translationZh: 在某些场合，红色运动鞋或休闲T恤能彰显身份地位；而在另一些场合则不然。
setting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

setting.sentenceEn: Although this is an interesting issue, it has nothing to do with the thesis, which explains how the setting influences Sammy's decision to quit his job. Instead of including that paragraph, she added one that described Lengel's crabbed response to the girls so that she could lead up to the A & P "policy" he enforces.
setting.translationZh: 尽管这是一个有趣的话题，但它与论文主题毫无关联——论文旨在阐释环境如何影响萨米做出辞职的决定。她没有包含那段文字，而是添加了一段描述伦格尔对女孩们不耐烦的回应，以此为引子，引出他所执行的A&P"政策"。

sex.sentenceEn: In signing the measure, California Governor Jerry Brown admitted that the law, which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex , is probably unconstitutional.
sex.translationZh: 在签署这项法案时，加利福尼亚州州长杰里·布朗承认，这项明确基于性别对人进行分类的法律可能违宪。
sex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

sex.sentenceEn: In South Africa, an HIV-prevention initiative known as loveLife recruits young people to promote safe sex among their peers.
sex.translationZh: 在南非，一项名为“loveLife”的艾滋病预防倡议招募年轻人在同龄人中推广安全性行为。

sex.sentenceEn: It usually leads to no good—drinking, drugs and casual sex .
sex.translationZh: 它通常不会带来什么好结果——比如酗酒、吸毒和随意性行为。

sex.sentenceEn: It was not until the mid-1980s, when amplifying age and sex differences became a dominant children's marketing strategy, that pink fully came into its own, when it began to seem inherently attractive to girls, part of what defined them as female, at least for the first few critical years.
sex.translationZh: 直到20世纪80年代中期，当放大年龄和性别差异成为儿童市场的主导营销策略时，粉色才真正盛行起来，并开始对女孩产生一种天生的吸引力，成为定义她们女性身份的一部分，至少在最初关键的几年里是如此。
sex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

sex.sentenceEn: The Taylor decision also declared sex discrimination in jury selection to be unconstitutional and ordered states to use the same procedures for selecting male and female jurors.
sex.translationZh: 泰勒案的判决还宣布在陪审团遴选中存在性别歧视是违宪的，并命令各州在遴选男性和女性陪审员时采用相同的程序。
sex.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

sex.sentenceEn: Marriage break-up stems from sex inequalities.
sex.translationZh: 婚姻破裂源于性别不平等。

significance.sentenceEn: Oman rated Scovell's significance highly, but at the same time, the general nature of his History meant that he could not analyze carefully what this obscure officer may or may not have contributed to that great struggle between nations or indeed tell us anything much about the man himself.
significance.translationZh: 奥曼高度评价斯科维尔的重要性，但同时，由于其《半岛战争史》的通史性质，他无法详细分析这位名不见经传的军官对那场国家间的伟大斗争可能做出了哪些贡献，也无法确切地告诉我们关于斯科维尔本人的更多信息。
significance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

significance.sentenceEn: Second, the majority of people who use networked computers to upload are not even aware of the significance of what they are doing.
significance.translationZh: 其次，大多数使用联网计算机上传内容的人甚至没有意识到自己行为的重要意义。
significance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

significance.sentenceEn: While comment and reaction from lawyers may enhance stories, it is preferable for journalists to rely on their own notions of significance and make their own judgments.
significance.translationZh: 尽管律师的评论和反馈可能会提升报道质量，但记者最好还是依靠自己对重要性的理解并做出独立判断。
significance.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
significance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

significance.sentenceEn: Because our conscious mind is occupied with daily life we don't always think about the emotional significance of the day's events – until, it appears, we begin to dream.
significance.translationZh: 因为我们的意识思维被日常生活所占据，所以并不总是会思考白天事件的情感意义——直到我们开始做梦，似乎才会这样做。

significance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

significance.sentenceEn: The significance of hot spots is not confined to their role as a frame of reference.

significance.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

slowly.sentenceEn: Because flammable material couldn't build up on the landscape, blazes tended to move slowly and peter out when they reached the footprints of previous burns.

slowly.sentenceEn: Lawmakers and regulators are slowly starting to address the ambiguity around dark patterns, most recently at the state level.
slowly.translationZh: 立法者和监管机构正逐步开始着手解决暗模式相关的模糊地带问题，最近的行动主要在州一级展开。
slowly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

slowly.sentenceEn: It peaks in young adulthood, levels out for a period of time, and then generally starts to slowly decline as we age.

slowly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

slowly.sentenceEn: Deep breaths can help, as can speaking more slowly and deliberately.

slowly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第4句

slowly.sentenceEn: Construction took 17 years as the building slowly rose wing by wing.

slowly.sentenceEn: Its rental vacancy rate is going up slowly .

suddenly.sentenceEn: I loved the man from the Thirties research who found that wireless suddenly offered "a lot of variety…things I thought I'd never be interested in…ice hockey perhaps".
