suddenly.sentenceEn: They are noting that the Victorians suddenly seem to become more human as the hundred-or-so years that separate us fade away through our common experience of laughter.
suddenly.translationZh: 人们注意到，当分隔我们的百余年时光通过共同的欢笑体验渐渐消散时，维多利亚时代的人们突然显得更具人情味了。
suddenly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

suddenly.sentenceEn: We suddenly can't remember where we put the keys just a moment ago, or an old acquaintance's name, or the name of an old band we used to love.
suddenly.translationZh: 我们突然想不起刚才把钥匙放在哪里了，或者某个老熟人的名字，又或是我们曾经喜爱的一支老乐队的名字。
suddenly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

suddenly.sentenceEn: When there is rapid improvement in the price and performance of technology, jobs that were once thought to be immune from automation suddenly become threatened.
suddenly.translationZh: 当技术的价格不断下降且性能迅速提升时，那些曾经被认为不会受到自动化影响的工作岗位突然变得岌岌可危。
suddenly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

suddenly.sentenceEn: Now the company is suddenly claiming that the 2002 agreement is invalid because of the 2006 legislation, and that only the federal government has regulatory power over nuclear issues.
suddenly.translationZh: 如今该公司突然宣称，由于2006年的立法，2002年的协议无效，并且只有联邦政府对核问题拥有监管权。
suddenly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

suddenly.sentenceEn: Suddenly , Britain looks to have fallen out with its favorite historical form.
suddenly.translationZh: 突然间，英国似乎不再青睐其最喜爱的历史书写形式。
suddenly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

scene.sentenceEn: Different parts of our brain engage as we simulate scenes , characters and mental states.
scene.translationZh: 当我们模拟场景、角色和心理状态时，大脑的不同区域会参与其中。

scene.sentenceEn: One example of how artists and scientists have together rocked the scenes came last month when the Sydney Symphony Orchestra performed a reworked version of Antonio Vivaldi's The Four Seasons.
scene.translationZh: 上个月，悉尼交响乐团演奏了安东尼奥·维瓦尔第《四季》的改编版本，这正是艺术家与科学家携手共创精彩的一个范例。
scene.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

scene.sentenceEn: Between 1807 and 1814 the Iberian Peninsula (comprising Spain and Portugal) was the scene of a titanic and merciless struggle.
scene.translationZh: 1807年至1814年间，伊比利亚半岛（包括西班牙和葡萄牙）成为一场激烈而残酷斗争的战场。
scene.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

scene.sentenceEn: The building has housed some of the nation's most significant diplomats and politicians and has been the scene of many historic events.
scene.translationZh: 这座建筑曾容纳过美国一些最重要的外交官和政治家，也见证了诸多历史性事件。

scene.sentenceEn: Behind the scenes , they have been taking aim at someone else: the accounting standard-setters.
scene.translationZh: 但在幕后，他们却把矛头对准了另一个群体：会计准则制定者。
scene.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

scene.sentenceEn: Natural scenes were taken into consideration.
scene.translationZh: 审美效果源于自然景观、新材料和明快的细节设计。

seriously.sentenceEn: At the same time, the European Union, Spain, Britain and several other countries have all seriously contemplated digital services taxes.
seriously.translationZh: 与此同时，欧盟、西班牙、英国以及其他几个国家都在认真考虑征收数字服务税。
seriously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

seriously.sentenceEn: "HGTV has seriously changed how people view real estate. It's not shelter, it's a lifestyle. With that mindset change come some serious money consequences."
seriously.translationZh: HGTV（家居与园艺电视网）已经严重改变了人们对房地产的看法。房产不再仅仅是住所，而是一种生活方式。这种观念的转变带来了一些严重的金钱后果。
seriously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第2句

seriously.sentenceEn: It allows us to have perspective on our lives – the ability to not take ourselves too seriously , to laugh at ourselves, to see the bigger picture, and to see that things will work out.
seriously.translationZh: 它使我们能够客观看待自己的生活——能够不过分较真，能够自嘲，能够看到更广阔的图景，并且相信事情总会向好的方向发展。
seriously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

seriously.sentenceEn: For one person, the goal may be to be taken more seriously and enhance their professional image.
seriously.translationZh: 对有些人而言，目标可能是希望自己更受重视，并提升职业形象。
seriously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

seriously.sentenceEn: A growing number of researchers and organisations are now thinking seriously about that question.
seriously.translationZh: 越来越多的研究人员和机构正在认真思考这个问题。
seriously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

seriously.translationZh: 这实际上会被认真对待

settle.sentenceEn: Flo Health and the FTC settled the matter with a Consent Order requiring the company to get app users' express affirmative consent before sharing their health information as well as to instruct the third parties to delete the data they had obtained.
settle.translationZh: Flo Health与联邦贸易委员会通过一项同意令解决了此事，该命令要求该公司在分享用户健康信息前必须获得应用用户明确的肯定性同意，并指示第三方删除已获取的数据。
settle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

settle.sentenceEn: Even more surprising is that more than half of "unretirees"—those who plan to work in retirement or went back to work after retiring—said they would be employed in their later years even if they had enough money to settle down, the survey showed.
settle.translationZh: 更令人惊讶的是，超过一半的“未退休者”——那些计划退休后继续工作或退休后重返职场的人——表示，即使他们有足够的钱安享晚年，也仍会在晚年继续工作。
settle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

settle.sentenceEn: Today's farm laborers, while still predominantly born in Mexico, are more likely to be settled rather than migrating and more likely to be married than single.
settle.translationZh: 如今的农场工人虽然仍主要出生于墨西哥，但他们更有可能已定居下来而非流动作业，且更有可能已婚而非单身。
settle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

settle.sentenceEn: Sexual confusion, economic frustrations, and religious hope – all came together in a decisive moment when he opened the Bible, told his father that the first line he saw would settle his fate, and read the magical words: "Come out from among them, touch no unclean thing, and I will be your God and you shall be my people."
settle.translationZh: 性的困惑、经济上的挫折以及宗教信仰——所有这些在他翻开《圣经》的那一刻汇聚成了一个决定性的时刻。他告诉父亲，自己看到的第一行经文将决定他的命运，然后读到了那句具有魔力的话语：“你们务要从他们中间出来，不要沾不洁净的物，我就收纳你们。我要作你们的神，你们要作我的子民。”
settle.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
settle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

settle.sentenceEn: I have been transformed from a passionate advocate of the philosophy of "having it all", preached by Linda Kelsey for the past seven years in the pages of She magazine, into a woman who is happy to settle for a bit of everything.
settle.translationZh: 我已从一个“拥有一切”理念的热情倡导者转变为一个乐于满足于“凡事只求一点”的女人。“拥有一切”这一理念是琳达·凯尔西过去七年来在《她》杂志上大力宣扬的。
settle.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
settle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

settle.sentenceEn: It will settle the prior controversies.

shock.sentenceEn: Half of the pens would deliver an electric shock when clicked.
shock.translationZh: 其中一半的钢笔在按下时会产生电击。
shock.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

shock.sentenceEn: When left alone in the room, the students who did not know which ones would shock them clicked more pens and incurred more shocks than the students who knew what would happen.
shock.translationZh: 当被单独留在房间里时，那些不知道哪些钢笔会产生电击的学生比知道会发生什么的学生点击了更多钢笔，也遭受了更多次电击。
shock.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

shock.sentenceEn: It has not gotten anywhere close to that, and one big reason is sticker shock : Passengers must pay $85 every five years to process their background checks.
shock.translationZh: 然而，这一目标远未实现，其中一个重要原因是费用高得令人咋舌：乘客每五年必须支付85美元进行背景调查。
shock.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

shock.sentenceEn: Without question, manufacturing has taken a significant hit during recent decades, and further trade deals raise questions about whether new shocks could hit manufacturing.
shock.translationZh: 毫无疑问，制造业在近几十年来遭受了重大打击，而新的贸易协定又引发了人们对制造业是否会遭遇新冲击的担忧。
shock.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

shock.sentenceEn: Some want to shock , others to draw people into science, or to better reward those who have made their careers in research.
shock.translationZh: 一些奖项设立者希望引起轰动，另一些则想吸引公众关注科学，或是为那些在科研领域成就事业的人提供更好的奖励。
shock.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

shock.sentenceEn: This near-tripling of oil prices calls up scary memories of the 1973 oil shock , when prices quadrupled, and 1979-1980, when they also almost tripled.
shock.translationZh: 油价近三倍的上涨唤起了人们对1973年石油危机的可怕记忆——当时油价上涨了四倍，以及1979至1980年的危机——当时油价也几乎上涨了三倍。
shock.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
shock.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

smartphone.sentenceEn: With multiple networks and countless podcasts, a smartphone user selects what to hear and when.
smartphone.translationZh: 面对众多的网络平台和无数的播客节目，智能手机用户可以自主选择收听的内容和时间。
smartphone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

smartphone.sentenceEn: It's enough to make a person put down the smartphone and go out front with a yard broom.
smartphone.translationZh: 这足以让人放下智能手机，拿着院子里的扫帚出门干活了。
smartphone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第6句

smartphone.sentenceEn: Scientists have employed a variety of ways to engage the general public in their research, such as making data analysis into an online game or sample collection into a smartphone application.
smartphone.translationZh: 科学家们采用了多种方式让普通公众参与他们的研究，例如将数据分析转化为在线游戏，或将样本收集开发为智能手机应用程序。
smartphone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

smartphone.sentenceEn: Microsoft's own Office dominates the market for "productivity" software, but the start-ups represented a new wave of technology designed from the ground up for the smartphone world.
smartphone.translationZh: 微软自家的Office软件主导着"生产力"软件市场，但这些初创公司代表了为智能手机世界从头打造的新一轮技术浪潮。
smartphone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

smartphone.sentenceEn: Today we live in a world where GPS systems, digital maps, and other navigation apps are available on our smartphones .
smartphone.translationZh: 如今，我们生活在一个智能手机上随处可见GPS系统、数字地图和其他导航应用的世界。
smartphone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

smartphone.sentenceEn: A smartphone may contain an arrestee's reading history, financial history, medical history and comprehensive records of recent correspondence.
smartphone.translationZh: 智能手机中可能包含被捕者的阅读记录、财务记录、医疗记录以及近期通讯的完整记录。
smartphone.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

smoking.sentenceEn: After all, it was rumoured that smoking caused cancer for years before the evidence was found to prove a connection.
smoking.translationZh: 毕竟，多年来一直有传言称吸烟会致癌，但很久之后才找到证据证明两者之间的关联。
smoking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

smoking.sentenceEn: "Dare to be different, please don't smoke!" pleads one billboard campaign aimed at reducing smoking among teenagers—teenagers, who desire nothing more than fitting in.
smoking.translationZh: "敢于与众不同，请勿吸烟！" 这是一个旨在减少青少年吸烟的广告牌宣传活动所发出的恳求——而青少年最渴望的恰恰是融入群体。
smoking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

smoking.sentenceEn: "Thirty years ago, it would have been inconceivable to have imagined a ban on smoking in the workplace or in pubs, and yet that is what we have now. Are we willing to be just as courageous in respect of obesity? I would suggest that we should be," said the leader of the UK's children's doctors.
smoking.translationZh: 英国儿科医生负责人表示：“三十年前，谁也无法想象会在工作场所或酒吧禁烟，然而如今这已成为现实。面对肥胖问题，我们是否也愿意展现同样的勇气？我认为我们应该如此。”
smoking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

smoking.sentenceEn: Professor Terence Stephenson, president of the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health, said that the consumption of unhealthy food should be seen to be just as damaging as smoking or excessive drinking.
smoking.translationZh: 英国皇家儿科与儿童健康学院院长特伦斯·斯蒂芬森教授表示，食用不健康食品的危害应被视为与吸烟或过量饮酒同样严重。
smoking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

smoking.sentenceEn: The food industry will be alarmed that such senior doctors back such radical moves, especially the call to use some of the tough tactics that have been deployed against smoking over the last decade.
smoking.translationZh: 食品行业会对如此资深的医生支持这类激进举措感到震惊，尤其是他们呼吁采用过去十年中用于控烟的部分强硬手段。
smoking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第1句

smoking.sentenceEn: Do you remember all those years when scientists argued that smoking would kill us but the doubters insisted that we didn't know for sure?
smoking.translationZh: 你还记得那些年吗？当时科学家们认为吸烟会致人死亡，但怀疑者却坚持认为我们尚无定论。
smoking.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
smoking.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

spark.sentenceEn: Ever since taking on Netflix Inc. at its own game, old Hollywood has struggled to turn a profit in streaming, with the likes of Disney+, Peacock and Paramount+ losing billions of dollars each year, sparking concerns that the services will never be as profitable as cable once was.
spark.translationZh: 自从开始与网飞公司(Netflix Inc.)在其主场展开竞争以来，传统好莱坞在流媒体业务上一直难以实现盈利。迪士尼+、孔雀(Peacock)和派拉蒙+等平台每年亏损数十亿美元，这引发了人们的担忧：这些流媒体服务可能永远无法像有线电视曾经那样盈利。
spark.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

spark.sentenceEn: In online spaces, desire paths have sparked a fascination that can approach obsession, with the Reddit page serving as a hub.
spark.translationZh: 在网络空间中，"欲望小径"引发了近乎痴迷的狂热，而Reddit相关板块则成为了这一现象的中心。
spark.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

spark.sentenceEn: Artifacts in museums have the power to inspire, and perhaps spark that need to learn and understand the nature of their creators.
spark.translationZh: 博物馆中的文物具有启发人心的力量，或许还能激发人们去了解和理解其创造者的本质。
spark.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

spark.sentenceEn: Things changed, however, when an innovative project-marketing manager came aboard, created a growth team and sparked the kind of fresh perspective they needed.
spark.translationZh: 然而，当一位富有创新精神的项目营销经理加入公司，组建了增长团队，并带来了他们所需的全新视角后，情况发生了改变。
spark.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

spark.sentenceEn: But it has already sparked significant controversy, with the United States trade representative opening an investigation into whether the tax discriminates against American companies, which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against France.
spark.translationZh: 但该法案已引发重大争议，美国贸易代表已着手调查这项税收是否歧视美国企业，这反过来可能导致美国对法国实施贸易制裁。
spark.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

spark.sentenceEn: This is because the networked computer has sparked a secret war between downloading and uploading – between passive consumption and active creation – whose outcome will shape our collective future in ways we can only begin to imagine.
spark.translationZh: 这是因为联网计算机引发了一场下载与上传之间的秘密战争——一场被动消费与主动创造之间的较量——其结果将以我们才刚刚开始想象的方式塑造我们共同的未来。

statistic.sentenceEn: An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK; official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England.
statistic.translationZh: 英国公共财政与会计学会的一项年度调查显示，全英此类机构数量接近 800 家；而英格兰艺术委员会的官方统计数据记录，在英格兰仅有 230 家。
statistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

statistic.sentenceEn: They gather all the data they can, not just performance statistics and biographical details but also the results of their own laboratory experiments with high achievers.
statistic.translationZh: 他们尽可能收集各种数据，不仅包括表现统计数据和生平细节，还包括他们自己对杰出成就者进行的实验室实验结果。
statistic.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
statistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

statistic.sentenceEn: This alone demonstrates that the television business is not an easy world to survive in, a fact underlined by statistics that show that out of eighty European television networks, no less than 50% took a loss in 1989.
statistic.translationZh: 仅此一点便足以证明，电视行业绝非易事，统计数据更印证了这一事实：1989年，在80家欧洲电视网中，亏损的不下50%。
statistic.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
statistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

statistic.sentenceEn: Nowhere do 1980 census statistics dramatize more the American search for spacious living than in the Far West.
statistic.translationZh: 1980年的人口普查数据最生动地表明，美国人对宽敞居住空间的追求在远西地区表现得最为突出。
statistic.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
statistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

statistic.sentenceEn: The official statistics are mildly discouraging.
statistic.translationZh: 官方统计数据略显令人失望。
statistic.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
statistic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

statistic.sentenceEn: Science Joins Push to Screen Statistics in Papers
statistic.translationZh: 《科学》杂志加入论文统计审查行动

substantial.sentenceEn: "The American Medical Association advises physicians that 'in situations where clear evidence of substantial driving impairment implies a strong threat to patient and public safety, and where the physician's advice to discontinue driving privileges is ignored, it is desirable and ethical to notify the Department of Motor Vehicles,'" Menke wrote.
substantial.translationZh: 门克写道：'美国医学协会建议医生，'当有明确证据表明驾驶员存在严重驾驶障碍，对患者本人及公共安全构成严重威胁，且医生关于终止驾驶特权的建议被忽视时，通知机动车管理部门是可取且符合伦理的做法。'
substantial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

substantial.sentenceEn: It is all very well train operators trumpeting the improvements they are making to the network, but passengers should be able to expect a basic level of service for the substantial sums they are now paying to travel.
substantial.translationZh: 铁路运营商大肆宣扬他们对铁路网所做的改进，这固然不错，但乘客支付了如此高昂的票价，理应享受到基本水平的服务。
substantial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

substantial.sentenceEn: In its latest survey of CEO pay, The Wall Street Journal finds that "a substantial part" of executive pay is now tied to performance.
substantial.translationZh: 《华尔街日报》在其最新的CEO薪酬调查中发现，高管薪酬的“很大一部分”现在与业绩挂钩。
substantial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

substantial.sentenceEn: "We estimate that either eliminating a substantial labour-rights concern, such as child labour, or increasing corporate giving by about 20% results in fines that generally are 40% lower than the typical punishment for bribing foreign officials," says one researcher.
substantial.translationZh: 一位研究人员表示：“我们估计，无论是消除重大劳工权益问题（如童工问题），还是将企业捐赠增加约20%，通常都能使罚款比贿赂外国官员的典型惩罚降低40%。”
substantial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

substantial.sentenceEn: Retailers that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe may well expect to rake in substantial profits thereby.
substantial.translationZh: 掌握欧洲批发业复杂运作的零售商完全有望因此获得丰厚利润。

substantial.sentenceEn: Or they could read Mr. Kirby's report: "The substantial buying power of such an agency would strengthen the public prescription-drug insurance plans to negotiate the lowest possible purchase prices from drug companies."
substantial.translationZh: 或者他们可以读一读柯比先生的报告："这样一个机构所拥有的强大购买力，将增强公共处方药保险计划与制药公司谈判的能力，以争取到尽可能低的采购价格。"
substantial.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）

subtle.sentenceEn: Ambady suspected that deliberation focused them on vivid but misleading cues, such as certain gestures or utterances, rather than letting the complex interplay of subtle signals form a holistic impression.
subtle.translationZh: 安巴迪猜测，深思熟虑使参与者将注意力集中在那些鲜明但具有误导性的线索上，比如某些手势或话语，而未能让微妙信号间的复杂相互作用形成一个整体印象。
subtle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

subtle.sentenceEn: Thankfully, there is a way out of this trap – but it involves striking a subtle balance.
subtle.translationZh: 值得庆幸的是，我们有办法摆脱这一困境——但这需要达成一种微妙的平衡。
subtle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

subtle.sentenceEn: But the headlong push into bachelor's degrees for all – and the subtle devaluing of anything less – misses an important point: That's not the only thing the American economy needs.
subtle.translationZh: 但是，盲目地推动所有人都去攻读学士学位——以及对低于学士学位的教育进行微妙贬低——忽略了一个重要问题：这并非美国经济唯一需要的东西。
subtle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

subtle.sentenceEn: This is a subtle form of peer pressure: we unconsciously imitate the behavior we see every day.
subtle.translationZh: 这是一种微妙的同伴压力：我们会无意识地模仿每天所看到的行为。
subtle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

subtle.sentenceEn: The subtle and intelligent little book The Marketplace of Ideas: Reform and Resistance in the American University should be read by every student thinking of applying to take a doctoral degree.
subtle.translationZh: 《思想市场：美国大学的改革与抵制》这本精妙而睿智的小书，值得每一位考虑申请攻读博士学位的学生一读。

subtle.sentenceEn: Some form of discrimination is too subtle to recognize.
subtle.translationZh: 某些形式的歧视过于微妙，难以察觉。
subtle.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）

sufficient.sentenceEn: The premise was that the common law of contract lacked sufficient safeguards for workers against arbitrary conduct by management.
sufficient.translationZh: 其前提是，普通合同法未能为劳动者提供足够的保护，以抵御管理层的任意行为。
sufficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

sufficient.sentenceEn: What makes the problem thornier is that the usual time-management techniques don't seem sufficient .
sufficient.translationZh: 让这个问题更棘手的是，通常的时间管理技巧似乎并不够用。
sufficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

sufficient.sentenceEn: A few generative rules are then sufficient to unfold the entire fundamental structure of a language, which is why children can learn it so quickly.
sufficient.translationZh: 由此，少量的生成规则便足以构建出一种语言的全部基本结构，这也解释了为何儿童能够如此迅速地学会语言。
sufficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

sufficient.sentenceEn: This increasingly high level of education is probably a necessary, but not a sufficient , condition for the complex political systems required by advanced economic performance.
sufficient.translationZh: 对于实现先进经济水平所需的复杂政治体制而言，这种日益提高的教育水平或许是必要条件，但并非充分条件。
sufficient.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
sufficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

sufficient.sentenceEn: Nancy Dubler, director of Montefiore Medical Center, contends that the principle will shield doctors who "until now have very, very strongly insisted that they could not give patients sufficient medication to control their pain if that might hasten death".
sufficient.translationZh: 蒙特菲奥里医疗中心主任南希·杜布勒认为，这一原则将为那些医生提供保护。这些医生“直到现在都一直坚定地认为，若给予患者足够的药物可能加速其死亡，他们就不能这样做来控制患者的疼痛”。
sufficient.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
sufficient.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

sufficient.sentenceEn: they are unable to get sufficient facilities.
sufficient.translationZh: 他们无法获得充足的设施。

suit.sentenceEn: For example, a busy street might not suit a motion-sensored door, as it would constantly be opening for passers-by.
suit.translationZh: 例如，繁忙的街道可能不适合安装运动感应门，因为它会不断为路人自动开启。
suit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

suit.sentenceEn: France's planned tax is a clear warning: Unless a broad consensus can be reached on reforming the international tax system, other nations are likely to follow suit , and American companies will face a cascade of different taxes from dozens of nations that will prove burdensome and costly.
suit.translationZh: 法国拟议的这项税收是一个明确的警告：除非各国能就国际税收体系改革达成广泛共识，否则其他国家很可能会纷纷效仿，而美国企业将面临数十个国家征收的一系列不同税收，这将被证明是既繁重又代价高昂的。
suit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

suit.sentenceEn: Within the complex social structure of the scientific community, researchers make discoveries; editors and reviewers act as gatekeepers by controlling the publication process; other scientists use the new finding to suit their own purposes; and finally, the public (including other scientists) receives the new discovery and possibly accompanying technology.
suit.translationZh: 在科学界复杂的社会结构中，研究者做出发现；编辑和评审人员通过控制发表流程扮演着守门人的角色；其他科学家则利用这一新发现来满足自身需求；最终，公众（包括其他科学家）接收这一新发现及其可能随之而来的技术。
suit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

suit.sentenceEn: John Donahue at Harvard's Kennedy School points out that the norms of culture in Western civil services suit those who want to stay put but are bad for high achievers.
suit.translationZh: 哈佛大学肯尼迪学院的约翰·多纳休指出，西方公务员制度的文化规范适合那些希望安于现状的人，但对业绩优异者不利。
suit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

suit.sentenceEn: As the industry advances, however, other suits may have an even greater impact.
suit.translationZh: 然而，随着该行业的发展，其他诉讼可能会产生更大的影响。
suit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

suit.sentenceEn: David Williams's suit should trouble this gambling nation. But don't bet on it.
suit.translationZh: 大卫·威廉姆斯的诉讼本应给这个赌博成风的国家敲响警钟，但别指望会有什么改变。
suit.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）

suitable.sentenceEn: Global heating is benefiting some species but others are too isolated to find suitable new habitat, and gardening habits—paving over gardens and using pesticides—aren't helping either.
suitable.translationZh: 全球变暖对某些物种有利，但另一些物种因过于孤立而无法找到合适的新栖息地，而园艺习惯——将花园铺上硬路面和使用杀虫剂——也无济于事。

suitable.sentenceEn: What intrinsic factors make the West a suitable home for these artifacts but preclude them from being preserved and displayed by their countries of origin?
suitable.translationZh: 究竟是哪些内在因素让西方成为这些文物的合适存放地，却又妨碍它们回归原产国进行保存和展示呢？
suitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第3句

suitable.sentenceEn: Even if we converted all the suitable land to fields of fruit and veg—which would involve taking out all the nature reserves and removing thousands of people from their homes—we would achieve only a 30 per cent boost in crop production.
suitable.translationZh: 即便我们将所有适宜耕种的土地都改种水果和蔬菜——这意味着要清除所有自然保护区并让数千人背井离乡——农作物产量也只能增加30%。
suitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

suitable.sentenceEn: Just 25 per cent of the country's land is suitable for crop-growing, most of which is already occupied by arable fields.
suitable.translationZh: 该国仅有25%的土地适合农作物种植，其中大部分已被耕地占用。
suitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

suitable.sentenceEn: Negotiated by USFWS and the states, the plan requires individuals and businesses that damage habitat as part of their operations to pay into a fund to replace every acre destroyed with 2 new acres of suitable habitat.
suitable.translationZh: 该计划由美国鱼类及野生动物管理局与各州协商制定，要求那些在经营活动中破坏栖息地的个人和企业向一项基金缴费，每破坏一英亩栖息地，须用两英亩新的适宜栖息地来替代。
suitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

suitable.sentenceEn: To read such books today is to marvel at the fact that their learned contents were once deemed suitable for publication in general-circulation dailies.
suitable.translationZh: 如今读这类书籍，我们不禁会惊叹：这些内容博大精深的文章，竟然曾被认为适合刊登在面向大众发行的日报上。
suitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

supportive.sentenceEn: We are eliminating a stage, booking fewer performers and making additional cuts to reduce our costs, all while striving to keep the festival as vibrant as ever, as supportive of local artists and businesses, and as true to Wicker Park's unique spirit and reputation as festgoers have come to expect.
supportive.translationZh: 我们正在通过取消一个舞台、减少表演嘉宾人数以及采取其他削减措施来降低成本。与此同时，我们仍将竭尽全力，确保音乐节一如既往地充满活力，继续支持当地艺术家和商家，并坚守参与者们所期待的柳条公园（Wicker Park）那独特的精神与名声。
supportive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

supportive.sentenceEn: Making friends is extremely important to teenagers, and many shy students need the security of some kind of organization with a supportive adult barely visible in the background.
supportive.translationZh: 结交朋友对青少年来说极为重要，许多腼腆的学生需要某种组织所提供的安全感，在这类组织中，有提供支持的成年人隐于幕后，几乎不被察觉。
supportive.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
supportive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

surprised.sentenceEn: But when Swetnam enrolled in graduate school at the University of Arizona's Laboratory of Tree-Ring Research, he was surprised to find a record of repeated blazes dating back hundreds of years before European colonists arrived on the continent.
surprised.translationZh: 但当斯韦特南进入亚利桑那大学年轮研究实验室攻读研究生时，他惊讶地发现，早在欧洲殖民者抵达美洲大陆之前的数百年间，这里就有过多次火灾记录。
surprised.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

surprised.sentenceEn: As I visited libraries up and down the country, I was surprised to learn there are more than twice the number of libraries (2,892) as there are branches of McDonald's.
surprised.translationZh: 当我走访全国各地的图书馆时，令我惊讶的是，图书馆的数量（2,892家）竟然是麦当劳门店数量的两倍还多。
surprised.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

surprised.sentenceEn: O'Hanlon said she had been most surprised by the "emotional literacy that was evident in the [target] children's writing" and that they were "more resilient in their writing, more hopeful".
surprised.translationZh: 奥汉隆表示，她最惊讶的是“[目标]儿童作品中展现出的情感认知能力”，以及他们“在写作中表现出更强的适应力和更积极的希望”。
surprised.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

surprised.sentenceEn: Rutkowski was initially surprised but thought it might be a good way to reach new audiences.
surprised.translationZh: 鲁特科夫斯基最初感到惊讶，但曾认为这或许是接触新受众的好途径。
surprised.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

surprised.sentenceEn: I was keen to read more, but was surprised to find that Oman's appendix, published in 1914, was the only considered thing that had been written about this secret war.
surprised.translationZh: 我渴望了解更多相关内容，却惊讶地发现， Oman 1914 年发表的附录，竟是关于这场秘密战争的唯一一篇经过深入研究的文献。
surprised.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

surprised.sentenceEn: People have been surprised to see evidence that Victorians had fun and could, and did, laugh.
surprised.translationZh: 看到维多利亚时代的人们也有娱乐活动，也会开怀大笑，而且确实笑过的证据，人们感到十分惊讶。
surprised.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

scheme.sentenceEn: The review recommends a national branding campaign to give libraries a stronger physical presence, the reintroduction of a scheme to enable members to use their card in any library in the country, and automatic memberships for children.
scheme.translationZh: 该审查报告建议发起一项全国性的品牌宣传活动，以增强图书馆的实体感；重新推行一项让会员持卡即可使用全国任一图书馆的计划；以及为儿童自动办理入会手续。
scheme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

scheme.sentenceEn: In Germany, one scheme has paired an old people's home with a nursery.
scheme.translationZh: 在德国，有一项计划将养老院与托儿所配对合作。
scheme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

scheme.sentenceEn: In order to "change lives for the better" and reduce "dependency", George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, introduced the "upfront work search" scheme .
scheme.translationZh: 为了“让生活更美好”并减少“依赖”，英国财政大臣乔治·奥斯本推出了“预先求职”计划。
scheme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

scheme.sentenceEn: Finally, there is perspective, which involves acknowledging that in the grand scheme of life, one lecture really doesn't matter.
scheme.translationZh: 最后是视角调整，这包括认识到在人生的宏大蓝图中，一次演讲真的无关紧要。
scheme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

scheme.sentenceEn: It seems clear that such a scheme is an initiative push toward what would eventually be a compulsory Internet "driver's license" mentality.
scheme.translationZh: 显然，这样的方案是朝着最终形成一种强制性互联网'驾照'思维模式迈出的主动一步。
scheme.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

scheme.sentenceEn: What prompted the chancellor to develop his scheme ?
scheme.translationZh: 是什么促使财政大臣制定了他的计划？

shared.sentenceEn: Navigating beyond the organised pavements and parks of our urban spaces, desire paths are the unofficial footprints of a community, revealing the unspoken preferences, shared shortcuts and collective choices of humans.
shared.translationZh: 在城市中规划整齐的人行道和公园之外，那些被称为'欲望小径'的非官方路径如同社区留下的隐形足迹，它们揭示了人们未曾言说的偏好、共同使用的捷径以及群体的集体选择。
shared.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

shared.sentenceEn: The alliances are most valuable when scientists and artists have a shared stake in a project, are able to jointly design it and can critique each other's work.
shared.translationZh: 当科学家和艺术家在一个项目中拥有共同的利益，能够共同设计项目并相互批评各自的工作时，这种合作联盟才最具价值。
shared.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

shared.sentenceEn: Now we can understand each other's positions and recognize our shared values, since we both care about needy workers.
shared.translationZh: 现在我们能够理解彼此的立场并认识到我们共同的价值观，因为我们都关心有需要的工人。

shared.sentenceEn: To filter out what is unique from what is shared might enable us to understand how complex cultural behavior arose and what guides it in evolutionary or cognitive terms.
shared.translationZh: 将文化中独特的部分与共有的部分区分开来，或许能让我们理解复杂的文化行为是如何产生的，以及在进化或认知层面是什么因素在引导这些行为。
shared.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

shared.sentenceEn: If you intend using humor in your talk to make people smile, you must know how to identify shared experiences and problems.
shared.translationZh: 如果你想在谈话中运用幽默逗人发笑，就必须知道如何识别听众共有的经历和问题。
shared.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
shared.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

shopper.sentenceEn: Shoppers also benefit from seeing exactly where—and to whom—their money is going.
shopper.translationZh: 购物者也能清楚地知道自己的钱流向了哪里、给了谁，这也是一大好处。
shopper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

shopper.sentenceEn: Surveys show that younger generations are more concerned about climate change, and some of the success of plant-based meat can be chalked up to shoppers wanting to signal their desire to protect the environment.
shopper.translationZh: 调查显示，年轻一代更加关注气候变化，而植物性肉类的部分成功可以归因于消费者希望表达他们保护环境的愿望。
shopper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

shopper.sentenceEn: States will be able to force more people to pay sales tax when they make online purchases under a Supreme Court decision Thursday that will leave shoppers with lighter wallets but is a big financial win for states.
shopper.translationZh: 根据最高法院周四做出的一项裁决，各州将有权强制更多人在网购时缴纳销售税。这一裁决虽会让消费者的钱包瘪下去，却是各州在财政上的一大胜利。
shopper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

shopper.sentenceEn: The sheer volume of available choice is enough to send shoppers into a state of information overload.
shopper.translationZh: 如此海量的选择足以让购物者陷入信息过载的状态。
shopper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

shopper.sentenceEn: It was only after "toddler" became a common shoppers ' term that it evolved into a broadly accepted developmental stage.
shopper.translationZh: 直到"学步儿童"成为购物者的常用术语后，它才演变为一个被广泛接受的发育阶段。
shopper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

shopper.sentenceEn: From car dealerships to Gap outlets, sales have been lagging for months as shoppers temper their spending.
shopper.translationZh: 从汽车经销商到盖璞门店，数月来销售额持续下滑，因为消费者都在缩减开支。
shopper.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
shopper.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

somewhat.sentenceEn: Therefore, unless customers are prepared to sign release agreements, the use of AI may become somewhat restricted in the future.
somewhat.translationZh: 因此，除非客户愿意签署数据使用授权协议，否则人工智能的应用在未来可能会受到一定限制。
somewhat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

somewhat.sentenceEn: While younger people are somewhat more optimistic than their elders about the prospects for those starting out today, big majorities in both groups believe those "just getting started in life" face a tougher climb than earlier generations in reaching such signpost achievements as securing a good-paying job, starting a family, managing debt, and finding affordable housing.
somewhat.translationZh: 尽管年轻人对如今初入社会者的前景比老一辈略显乐观，但两个群体中的绝大多数人都认为，那些"刚刚起步的人"在实现诸如获得高薪工作、组建家庭、管理债务和找到经济适用住房等标志性成就方面，比前几代人面临更艰难的奋斗。
somewhat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

somewhat.sentenceEn: Likewise, among the elderly, being somewhat overweight is often an indicator of good health.
somewhat.translationZh: 同样，在老年人中，体重略超通常是健康状况良好的标志。
somewhat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

somewhat.sentenceEn: Time was when biologists somewhat overworked the evidence that these creatures preserve the health of game by killing the physically weak, or that they prey only on "worthless" species.
somewhat.translationZh: 曾几何时，生物学家们也有些过度宣扬这样的证据：这些生物通过捕食体弱的个体来维持猎物群体的健康，或者它们只捕食那些“毫无价值”的物种。
somewhat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

somewhat.sentenceEn: Later, this idea became known as the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis, but this term is somewhat inappropriate.
somewhat.translationZh: 后来，这一观点被称为“萨丕尔-沃尔夫假说”，但这个术语并不十分恰当。
somewhat.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
somewhat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

somewhat.sentenceEn: Often they chose—and still are choosing— somewhat colder climates such as Oregon, Idaho and Alaska in order to escape smog, crime and other plagues of urbanization in the Golden State.
somewhat.translationZh: 他们往往选择——并且现在仍然选择——气候略冷的地区，如俄勒冈州、爱达荷州和阿拉斯加州，以逃避“金州”（加利福尼亚州）的烟雾、犯罪和其他城市化带来的问题。
somewhat.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
somewhat.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第12段，第2句

specialisation.sentenceEn: But the key idea behind professionalisation, argues Mr. Menand, is that "the knowledge and skills needed for a particular specialisation are transmissible but not transferable."
specialisation.translationZh: 但梅南先生认为，专业化背后的核心观点是：'特定专业所需的知识和技能可以传授，但不可迁移。'

specialisation.sentenceEn: Although the process of professionalisation and specialisation was already well under way in British geology during the nineteenth century, its full consequences were thus delayed until the twentieth century.
specialisation.translationZh: 尽管19世纪英国地质学领域的专业化和专门化进程已全面展开，但其全部影响却延至20世纪才充分显现。
specialisation.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
specialisation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

specialisation.sentenceEn: Specialisation can be seen as a response to the problem of an increasing accumulation of scientific knowledge.
specialisation.translationZh: 专业化可视为对科学知识日益积累这一问题的应对之策。
specialisation.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
specialisation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

specialisation.sentenceEn: The growth of specialisation in the nineteenth century, with its consequent requirement of a longer, more complex training, implied greater problems for amateur participation in science.
specialisation.translationZh: 19世纪专业化的发展使得从事科研活动需要接受更长时间、更复杂的训练，这给业余爱好者参与科学研究带来了更大的困难。
specialisation.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
specialisation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

specialisation.sentenceEn: But specialisation was only one of a series of related developments in science affecting the process of communication.
specialisation.translationZh: 但是专业化只是科学领域中一系列相关发展趋势之一，这些发展都影响着科学交流的过程。
specialisation.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
specialisation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

sponsor.sentenceEn: They include materials sponsored by energy industry associations.
sponsor.translationZh: 其中包括由能源行业协会赞助的材料。
sponsor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

sponsor.sentenceEn: Next time somebody pushes corporate quotas as a way to promote gender equity, remember that such policies are largely self-serving measures that make their sponsors feel good but do little to help average women.
sponsor.translationZh: 下次有人把企业配额作为促进性别平等的手段时，请记住，这类政策在很大程度上是自私自利的措施，它们让制定者自我感觉良好，却对普通女性几乎没有帮助。
sponsor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

sponsor.sentenceEn: A pair of bills sponsored by Massachusetts state Senator Jason Lewis and House Speaker Pro Tempore Patricia Haddad, to ensure "gender parity" on boards and commissions, provides a case in point.
sponsor.translationZh: 马萨诸塞州参议员杰森·刘易斯和众议院临时议长帕特里夏·哈达德提出的两项法案旨在确保各委员会和董事会实现"性别平等"，这就是一个恰当的例子。
sponsor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

sponsor.sentenceEn: Such a move could affect firms such as McDonald's, which sponsors the youth coaching scheme run by the Football Association.
sponsor.translationZh: 这一举措可能会影响像麦当劳这样的公司，该公司赞助了由英格兰足球总会运营的青少年教练项目。
sponsor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

sponsor.sentenceEn: However, the typical teenage lifestyle is already filled with so much competition that it would be wise to plan activities in which there are more winners than losers, for example, publishing newsletters with many student-written book reviews, displaying student artwork, and sponsoring book discussion clubs.
sponsor.translationZh: 然而，青少年典型的生活方式已经充满了激烈的竞争，因此明智的做法是设计一些让成功者多于失败者的活动，例如，出版刊登多篇学生撰写的书评的简报，展示学生的艺术作品，以及主办读书讨论俱乐部。
sponsor.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
sponsor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

sponsor.translationZh: 该研究由163个国家共同发起。

stem.sentenceEn: Though plants lack brains, the firing of electrical signals in their stems and leaves nonetheless triggered responses that hinted at consciousness, researchers previously reported.
stem.translationZh: 研究人员此前曾报告称，尽管植物没有大脑，但其茎和叶中电信号的传递仍会引发暗示意识存在的反应。
stem.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

stem.sentenceEn: Some growth stems from a commitment by governments and farsighted businesses to fund cleaner energy sources.
stem.translationZh: 部分增长源于政府和有远见的企业承诺为清洁能源提供资金支持。
stem.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

stem.sentenceEn: The way consumers now approach the process of making purchase decisions means that marketing's impact stems from a broad range of factors beyond conventional paid media.
stem.translationZh: 如今消费者做出购买决策的方式意味着，市场营销的影响力来源于传统付费媒体之外的广泛因素。
stem.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

stem.sentenceEn: The researchers' argument stems from a simple observation about social influence: With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey – whose outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal, influence – even the most influential members of a population simply don't interact with that many others.
stem.translationZh: 研究人员的观点源于对社会影响力的一个简单观察：除了少数像奥普拉·温弗瑞这样的名人——他们的巨大影响力主要源于媒体而非人际影响——即使是一个群体中最具影响力的人物，实际上也不会与那么多人产生互动。
stem.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

stem.sentenceEn: However, whether such a sense of fairness evolved independently in capuchins and humans, or whether it stems from the common ancestor that the species had 35 million years ago, is, as yet, an unanswered question.
stem.translationZh: 然而，这种公平感究竟是卷尾猴和人类各自独立进化而来，还是源自3500万年前这两个物种的共同祖先，至今仍是一个未解之谜。
stem.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
stem.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第6句

stem.sentenceEn: These issues all have root causes in human behavior: all require behavioral change and social innovations, as well as technological development. Stemming climate change, for example, is as much about changing consumption patterns and promoting tax acceptance as it is about developing clean energy.
stem.translationZh: 这些问题的根源都在于人类行为：所有问题的解决不仅需要技术发展，还需要行为改变和社会创新。例如，遏制气候变化既要发展清洁能源，也要改变消费模式和提高税收接受度。

streaming.sentenceEn: ACE says it's helped shrink the number of illegal streaming services in North America to 126, from more than 1,400 in 2018, aided in part by the MPA's support for a 2020 federal law that made large-scale streaming of copyrighted material a serious crime.
streaming.translationZh: 美国电影协会（ACE）表示，其已协助将北美地区的非法流媒体服务数量从2018年的1400多家减少至126家。这在一定程度上得益于MPA支持的2020年联邦法律，该法律将大规模流媒体传播受版权保护的材料定为严重犯罪。
streaming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

streaming.sentenceEn: But the age of streaming has been a boon for some unintended winners: pirates that use software to rip a film or television show in seconds from legitimate online video platforms and host the titles on their own, illegitimate services, which rake in about $2 billion annually from ads and subscriptions.
streaming.translationZh: 但流媒体时代却意外地成就了一批赢家：盗版者利用软件在几秒钟内从合法在线视频平台上窃取电影或电视节目，然后将这些内容放在自己的非法网站上。这些盗版网站每年通过广告和订阅能赚取约20亿美元。
streaming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

streaming.sentenceEn: With no video production costs, illegal streaming sites have achieved profit margins approaching 90%, according to the Motion Picture Association (MPA), a trade group representing Hollywood studios that's working to crack down on the thousands of illegal platforms that have cropped up in recent years.
streaming.translationZh: 据代表好莱坞各大制片厂的行业组织——美国电影协会（MPA）称，由于没有视频制作成本，非法流媒体网站的利润率已接近90%。该协会正致力于打击近年来涌现的数千个非法平台。
streaming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

streaming.sentenceEn: Ever since taking on Netflix Inc. at its own game, old Hollywood has struggled to turn a profit in streaming , with the likes of Disney+, Peacock and Paramount+ losing billions of dollars each year, sparking concerns that the services will never be as profitable as cable once was.
streaming.translationZh: 自从开始与网飞公司(Netflix Inc.)在其主场展开竞争以来，传统好莱坞在流媒体业务上一直难以实现盈利。迪士尼+、孔雀(Peacock)和派拉蒙+等平台每年亏损数十亿美元，这引发了人们的担忧：这些流媒体服务可能永远无法像有线电视曾经那样盈利。
streaming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

streaming.sentenceEn: But now piracy involving illegal streaming services as well as file-sharing costs the US economy about $30 billion in lost revenue a year and some 250,000 jobs, estimates the US Chamber of Commerce's Global Innovation Policy Center.
streaming.translationZh: 但美国商会全球创新政策中心估计，如今涉及非法流媒体服务和文件共享的盗版行为每年给美国经济造成约300亿美元的收入损失，并导致约25万个就业岗位流失。
streaming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

streaming.sentenceEn: Yet the FCC also ended the investigations of broadband providers that imposed data caps on their rivals' streaming services but not their own.
streaming.translationZh: 然而，联邦通信委员会也终止了对宽带服务商的调查，这些服务商对竞争对手的流媒体服务设置了数据上限，却对自家服务网开一面。
streaming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

subscriber.sentenceEn: Back then platforms such as Netflix, Amazon and Apple TV hemorrhaged billions of dollars to generate content to attract new subscribers , resulting in 633 scripted series being released that year.
subscriber.translationZh: 当时，Netflix、亚马逊和 Apple TV 等平台投入了数十亿美元来制作内容以吸引新订阅者，导致当年发布的剧本剧集达到了 633 部。
subscriber.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

subscriber.sentenceEn: As the streamers' emphasis changed from subscriber growth to profitability, prices for the services went up and the number of new shows went down to 481 released in 2023, with the number expected to dip into the 300s within a few years.
subscriber.translationZh: 随着流媒体平台的工作重心从用户增长转向盈利，各项服务价格随之上涨，而新剧集的数量在2023年降至481部，预计未来几年内这一数字还将跌破400部。
subscriber.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

subscriber.sentenceEn: There is the so-called big deal, where institutional subscribers pay for access to a collection of online journal titles through site-licensing agreements.
subscriber.translationZh: 第一种是所谓的"大宗交易"模式，即机构订阅者通过网站许可协议付费获取一系列在线期刊的访问权限。
subscriber.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
subscriber.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

subscriber.sentenceEn: Other models exist that are hybrids of these three, such as delayed open-access, where journals allow only subscribers to read a paper for the first six months, before making it freely available to everyone who wishes to see it.
subscriber.translationZh: 还存在一些融合了这三种模式的混合模式，例如延迟开放获取模式，即期刊在前六个月只允许订阅者阅读论文，之后才向所有希望阅读的人免费开放。
subscriber.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
subscriber.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

subscriber.sentenceEn: Subscribers can customize the information they want to receive and proceed directly to a company's Web site.
subscriber.translationZh: 用户可以自定义想要接收的信息，并直接进入公司网站。
subscriber.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
subscriber.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

subscriber.sentenceEn: subscribers were unhappy with new shows.
subscriber.translationZh: 订阅者对新节目感到不满。

suicide.sentenceEn: Seymour made the change, went into his backyard, and expressed his displeasure by committing suicide .
suicide.translationZh: 西摩按要求修改了画作，随后走进后院，以自杀的方式表达了他的不满。

suicide.sentenceEn: The Supreme Court's decisions on physician-assisted suicide carry important implications for how medicine seeks to relieve dying patients of pain and suffering.
suicide.translationZh: 最高法院关于医生协助自杀的裁决，对医学界如何致力于减轻临终患者的痛苦具有重要意义。
suicide.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
suicide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

suicide.sentenceEn: "We don't call those deaths homicides because the doctors didn't intend to kill their patients, although they risked their death. If you're a physician, you can risk your patient's suicide as long as you don't intend their suicide ."
suicide.translationZh: 我们不会将这些死亡称作杀人，因为医生并没有意图杀死患者，尽管他们冒着导致患者死亡的风险。如果你是医生，只要你没有意图让患者自杀，你就可以冒患者自杀的风险。
suicide.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
suicide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

suicide.sentenceEn: Although it ruled that there is no constitutional right to physician-assisted suicide , the Court in effect supported the medical principle of "double effect", a centuries-old moral principle holding that an action having two effects—a good one that is intended and a harmful one that is foreseen—is permissible if the actor intends only the good effect.
suicide.translationZh: 尽管最高法院裁定宪法并未赋予医生协助自杀的权利，但实际上支持了"双重效果"这一医疗原则——这是一项有着数百年历史的道德准则，认为如果一个行为可能产生两种结果（一种是期望达到的良好效果，另一种是可预见的不良效果），只要行为实施者仅意图实现良好效果，该行为就是可允许的。
suicide.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
suicide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

suicide.sentenceEn: Just three weeks before the Court's ruling on physician-assisted suicide , the National Academy of Science (NAS) released a two-volume report, Approaching Death: Improving Care at the End of Life.
suicide.translationZh: 就在最高法院对医生协助自杀作出裁决的三周前，美国国家科学院（NAS）发布了一份两卷本报告——《走近死亡：改善生命末期护理》。
suicide.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
suicide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

suicide.sentenceEn: In the past decade, the Japanese divorce rate, while still well below that of the United States, has increased by more than 50 percent, and suicides have increased by nearly one-quarter.
suicide.translationZh: 在过去十年中，日本的离婚率虽然仍远低于美国，但已上升了50%以上，自杀率也增长了近四分之一。
suicide.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
suicide.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

salary.sentenceEn: Today's tip requests are often not connected to the salary and service norms that used to determine when and how people tip.
salary.translationZh: 如今的小费请求往往与过去决定人们何时以及如何给小费的薪资和服务规范脱节。
salary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

salary.sentenceEn: Furthermore, the highest CEO salaries are paid to outside candidates, not to the cozy insider picks, another sign that high CEO pay is not some kind of depredation at the expense of the rest of the company.
salary.translationZh: 此外，最高的CEO薪资支付给了外部候选人，而非关系密切的内部人选，这进一步表明，高额CEO薪酬并非以牺牲公司其他利益为代价的掠夺行为。
salary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

salary.sentenceEn: Even if a job's starting salary seems too small to satisfy an emerging adult's need for rapid content, the transition from school to work can be less of a setback if the start-up adult is ready for the move.
salary.translationZh: 即便一份工作的起薪看似微薄，无法满足初入社会的年轻人对快速获得满足感的需求，但如果这些初涉职场的年轻人做好了准备，从学校到职场的过渡也不会那么令人受挫。
salary.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
salary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

salary.sentenceEn: They may teach very well, and more than earn their salaries , but most of them make little or no independent reflections on human problems which involve moral judgment.
salary.translationZh: 他们或许书教得很好，而且不仅仅是为了谋生，但他们大多数人很少或根本没有对涉及道德判断的人类问题进行独立思考。
salary.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
salary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

salary.sentenceEn: It's an interactive feature that lets visitors key in job criteria such as location, title, and salary , then E-mails them when a matching position is posted in the database.
salary.translationZh: 这是一项交互式功能，允许访问者输入地点、职位和薪水等求职标准，当数据库中发布匹配职位时，系统会通过电子邮件通知他们。
salary.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
salary.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

sample.sentenceEn: Scientists have employed a variety of ways to engage the general public in their research, such as making data analysis into an online game or sample collection into a smartphone application.
sample.translationZh: 科学家们采用了多种方式让普通公众参与他们的研究，例如将数据分析转化为在线游戏，或将样本收集开发为智能手机应用程序。
sample.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

sample.sentenceEn: The same people were used in both samples .
sample.translationZh: 两组样本使用的是同一批研究对象。
sample.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

sample.sentenceEn: Typically, they survey and sample (make test excavations on) large areas of terrain to determine where excavation will yield useful information.
sample.translationZh: 通常情况下，他们会对大片区域进行勘察和取样（即进行试挖掘），以确定在哪里挖掘能获得有用的信息。

sample.sentenceEn: Surveys and test samples have also become important for understanding the larger landscapes that contain archaeological sites.
sample.translationZh: 勘测和试掘样本对于理解包含考古遗址的更广阔地貌也变得至关重要。

sample.sentenceEn: But Dr Uri Simonsohn speculated that an inability to consider the big picture was leading decision-makers to be biased by the daily samples of information they were working with.
sample.translationZh: 但尤里·西蒙松博士推测，这种无法考虑全局的能力缺陷会导致决策者受到他们日常接触的信息样本的影响而产生偏见。
sample.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

sample.sentenceEn: But in late September 2009, officials reported there was significant flu activity in almost every state and that virtually all the samples tested are the new swine flu, also known as (A) H1N1, not seasonal flu.
sample.translationZh: 但到2009年9月末，官员们报告称几乎每个州都出现了显著的流感疫情，且几乎所有检测样本均为新型猪流感（也称为甲型H1N1流感），而非季节性流感。
sample.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

section.sentenceEn: To those of you in the comments section who are having strong feelings about artifacts being removed from cities in the U.S. and Britain and returned to their countries of origin, I would ask you to consider why do you think Americans have more of a right to easily access the Benin Bronzes than the people of Nigeria?
section.translationZh: 对于评论区中那些对从美国和英国城市移走文物并将其归还给原籍国一事怀有强烈情绪的人，我想请你们思考：为什么你们认为美国人比尼日利亚人更有权利轻松接触到贝宁青铜器？
section.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

section.sentenceEn: Section 5 of the FTC Act empowers the FTC to initiate enforcement action against unfair or deceptive acts, meaning the FTC can only act after the fact if a company's privacy practices are misleading or cause unjustified consumer harm.
section.translationZh: 《联邦贸易委员会法案》第5条授权联邦贸易委员会对不公平或欺骗性行为采取执法行动，这意味着只有当某公司的隐私做法具有误导性或对消费者造成不正当损害时，联邦贸易委员会才能在事后采取行动。
section.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

section.sentenceEn: The trade magazine The Bookseller reported that Waterstones branch managers were being told to remove PRH books from prominent areas such as tables, display spaces and windows, and were "quietly retiring them to their relevant sections ".
section.translationZh: 行业杂志《书商》报道称，水石书店各分店经理接到指示，要求将企鹅兰登书屋的书籍从展台、陈列区和橱窗等显眼位置移走，并将其“悄然归位到相应的分类区域”。
section.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

section.sentenceEn: Comprising artists Mark Boyle and Joan Hills and their children, they recreated random sections of the British landscape on gallery walls.
section.translationZh: 该艺术组合由艺术家马克·博伊尔、琼·希尔斯夫妇及其子女组成，他们在画廊的墙壁上随机重现了英国 landscape 的局部景致。
section.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

section.sentenceEn: This law abolished special educational requirements for federal jurors and required them to be selected at random from a cross section of the entire community.
section.translationZh: 该法律废除了联邦陪审员的特殊教育要求，并规定必须从整个社区的代表性群体中随机挑选陪审员。
section.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

section.sentenceEn: Why did Waterstones shops retire PRH books to their relevant sections ?
section.translationZh: 为何水石书店要将企鹅兰登书屋的书籍移至其相关分类区域？

skilled.sentenceEn: Later civilisations would value the skilled blacksmith's labour in a nail even more than the raw material.
skilled.translationZh: 后世文明更看重钉子中蕴含的铁匠精湛技艺，而非其原材料本身。
skilled.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

skilled.sentenceEn: Rosenberg argues convincingly that public-health advocates ought to take a page from advertisers, so skilled at applying peer pressure.
skilled.translationZh: 罗森伯格令人信服地指出，公共卫生倡导者应当向广告商学习，后者深谙如何运用同辈压力。
skilled.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

skilled.sentenceEn: They fear that it hurts their economies, depriving them of much-needed skilled workers who could have taught at their universities, worked in their hospitals and come up with clever new products for their factories to make.
skilled.translationZh: 他们担心这会损害本国经济，使他们失去急需的技术人才——这些人本可以在大学任教、在医院工作，或为工厂研发出新颖的产品。
skilled.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

skilled.sentenceEn: And thanks to the continual miniaturization of electronics and micro-mechanics, there are already robot systems that can perform some kinds of brain and bone surgery with submillimeter accuracy—far greater precision than highly skilled physicians can achieve with their hands alone.
skilled.translationZh: 而且，得益于电子器件和微机械技术的不断微型化，已经出现了能够进行某些脑部和骨科手术的机器人系统，其精度可达亚毫米级——这远非技术精湛的医生仅靠双手就能达到的精准度。
skilled.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
skilled.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

skilled.sentenceEn: In order to study particular cultures as completely as possible, he became skilled in linguistics, the study of languages, and in physical anthropology, the study of human biology and anatomy.
skilled.translationZh: 为了尽可能全面地研究特定文化，博厄斯精通了语言学（即对语言的研究）和体质人类学（即对人类生物学与解剖学的研究）。
skilled.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）

snap.sentenceEn: Jackson snapped the first-ever shots of iconic landmarks such as the Tetons, Old Faithful and the Colorado Rockies on a late 19th-century expedition through the Yellowstone Basin, conducted by the head of the U.S. Geological and Geographical Survey of the Territories, Ferdinand V. Hayden.
snap.translationZh: 19世纪后期，在美国领土地质与地理调查局局长费迪南德·V·海登的带领下，一行人穿越黄石盆地进行考察。期间，杰克逊拍摄了一系列标志性地标——包括提顿山脉、老忠实泉和科罗拉多落基山脉——的首批照片。

snap.sentenceEn: John Gottman, the marriage expert, explains that we quickly "thin slice" information reliably only after we ground such snap reactions in "thick sliced" long-term study.
snap.translationZh: 婚姻专家约翰·戈特曼解释说，只有将这种快速反应建立在长期的"深度剖析"研究基础上，我们才能可靠地对信息进行快速"薄片式"解读。
snap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

snap.sentenceEn: Scientists have found that although we are prone to snap overreactions, if we take a moment and think about how we are likely to react, we can reduce or even eliminate the negative effects of our quick, hard-wired responses.
snap.translationZh: 科学家发现，尽管我们容易做出快速的过度反应，但如果我们花一点时间思考自己可能会如何反应，就能减少甚至消除这种快速、本能反应所带来的负面影响。
snap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

snap.sentenceEn: But snap decisions in reaction to rapid stimuli aren't exclusive to the interpersonal realm.
snap.translationZh: 但是，对快速刺激做出的瞬时决策并不局限于人际交往领域。
snap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

snap.sentenceEn: Snap decisions can be important defense mechanisms; if we are judging whether someone is dangerous, our brains and bodies are hard-wired to react very quickly, within milliseconds.
snap.translationZh: 快速决策可能是重要的防御机制；当我们判断某人是否具有危险性时，我们的大脑和身体会本能地在几毫秒内做出快速反应。
snap.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

sparrow.sentenceEn: In 2011, Sparrow led a study in which participants were asked to record 40 factoids in a computer ("an ostrich's eye is bigger than its brain," for example).
sparrow.translationZh: 2011年，斯派洛主导了一项研究，参与者被要求在电脑中记录40条趣闻知识（例如，“鸵鸟的眼睛比它的大脑还大”）。
sparrow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

sparrow.sentenceEn: In other words, human memory is not deteriorating but "adapting to new communications technology," Sparrow says.
sparrow.translationZh: 斯派洛说，换句话说，人类的记忆力并没有衰退，而是在'适应新的通信技术'。
sparrow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第8句

sparrow.sentenceEn: The Internet may be changing merely what we remember, not our capacity to do so, suggests Columbia University psychology professor Betsy Sparrow .
sparrow.translationZh: 哥伦比亚大学心理学教授贝齐·斯派洛指出，互联网可能仅仅改变了我们记忆的内容，而非我们的记忆能力。
sparrow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

sparrow.sentenceEn: "I personally have never seen all that much intellectual value in memorizing things," Sparrow says, adding that we haven't lost our ability to do it.
sparrow.translationZh: 斯派洛说：“我个人从不认为记忆事物有那么多的智力价值。”她补充道，我们并没有失去记忆能力。
sparrow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

sparrow.sentenceEn: Some worry that this is having a destructive effect on society, but Sparrow sees an upside.
sparrow.translationZh: 一些人担心这会对社会产生破坏性影响，但斯派洛却看到了积极的一面。
sparrow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

sparrow.sentenceEn: Which of the following would Sparrow support about the Internet?
sparrow.translationZh: 关于互联网，斯派罗会支持以下哪项观点？

spouse.sentenceEn: In theory, a girl may veto the spouse her parents have chosen.
spouse.translationZh: 理论上，女孩可以否决父母为其选择的配偶。
spouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

spouse.sentenceEn: Each spouse retains whatever property he or she brought into the marriage, and jointly-acquired property is divided equally.
spouse.translationZh: 夫妻双方各自保留婚前带入婚姻的所有财产，婚后共同获得的财产则平均分配。
spouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

spouse.sentenceEn: A young man can decide on a likely spouse on his own and then ask his parents to arrange the marriage negotiations, or the young man's parents may make the choice of a spouse , giving the child little to say in the selection.
spouse.translationZh: 年轻男子可以自己选定心仪的配偶，再请父母安排提亲事宜；或者，也可能由男方父母为其选定配偶，在这个过程中，孩子几乎没有发言权。
spouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

spouse.sentenceEn: After a spouse has been selected, each family investigates the other to make sure its child is marrying into a good family.
spouse.translationZh: 选定配偶后，双方家庭会互相考察，以确保自己的孩子能嫁入或娶入一个好家庭。
spouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

spouse.sentenceEn: In Cambodia, the choice of a spouse is a complex one for the young male.
spouse.translationZh: 在柬埔寨，年轻男性选择配偶是一件复杂的事情。
spouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

spouse.sentenceEn: Work with a professional photographer instead of your spouse or friend.
spouse.translationZh: 请专业摄影师为你拍摄，而非让配偶或朋友代劳。
spouse.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第4句

statistical.sentenceEn: Working with the American Statistical Association, the journal has appointed seven experts to a statistics board of reviewing editors (SBoRE).
statistical.translationZh: 《科学》杂志与美国统计协会合作，已任命七位专家组成统计审稿编辑委员会（SBoRE）。
statistical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

statistical.sentenceEn: Professional scientists are expected to know how to analyse data, but statistical errors are alarmingly common in published research, according to David Vaux, a cell biologist.
statistical.translationZh: 细胞生物学家大卫·沃克斯表示，专业科学家理应懂得如何分析数据，但已发表的研究中统计错误却多得出奇。
statistical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

statistical.sentenceEn: "Most journals are weak in statistical review, and this damages the quality of what they publish. I think that, for the majority of scientific papers nowadays, statistical review is more essential than expert review," he says, but he noted that biomedical journals such as Annals of Internal Medicine, the Journal of the American Medical Association and The Lancet pay strong attention to statistical review.
statistical.translationZh: 他表示：“大多数期刊在统计审查方面较为薄弱，这损害了它们发表内容的质量。我认为，对于当今大多数科学论文而言，统计审查比专家审查更为关键。”但他也指出，像《内科医学年鉴》、《美国医学会杂志》和《柳叶刀》等生物医学期刊对统计审查给予了高度重视。
statistical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

statistical.sentenceEn: The journal Science is adding an extra round of statistical checks to its peer-review process, editor-in-chief Marcia McNutt announced today.
statistical.translationZh: 《科学》杂志主编马西娅·麦克纳特今日宣布，该期刊将在其同行评审流程中新增一轮统计数据核查。
statistical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

statistical.sentenceEn: Social psychologists have amassed oceans of research into what they call the "above average effect", or "illusory superiority", and shown that, for example, 70% of us rate ourselves as above average in leadership, 93% in driving and 85% at getting on well with others – all obviously statistical impossibilities.
statistical.translationZh: 社会心理学家已积累了海量关于他们称之为“高于平均水平效应”或“虚幻优越感”的研究，并指出，例如，70%的人认为自己的领导力高于平均水平，93%的人认为自己的驾驶能力高于平均水平，85%的人认为自己与人相处的能力高于平均水平——这些在统计学上显然都是不可能的。
statistical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

statistical.sentenceEn: Superhigh scores like vos Savant's are no longer possible, because scoring is now based on a statistical population distribution among age peers, rather than simply dividing the mental age by the chronological age and multiplying by 100.
statistical.translationZh: 像沃斯·莎凡特那样的超高智商分数已不再可能出现，因为现在的评分是基于同龄人群体的统计分布，而非简单地用心理年龄除以实际年龄再乘以100。
statistical.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
statistical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

strain.sentenceEn: For example, a high growth rate placed great strains on the existing structures of governance, of administration, and above all of socialization.
strain.translationZh: 例如，高增长率给现有的治理结构、行政结构，尤其是社会化结构带来了巨大压力。
strain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

strain.sentenceEn: For H&M to offer a $5.95 knit miniskirt in all its 2,300-plus stores around the world, it must rely on low-wage overseas labor, order in volumes that strain natural resources, and use massive amounts of harmful chemicals.
strain.translationZh: 为了能在全球2300多家门店推出这款5.95美元的针织迷你裙，H&M必须依赖海外廉价劳动力，订购量之大足以耗尽自然资源，并且大量使用有害化学物质。
strain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

strain.sentenceEn: In fact, instead of straining muscles to build them, as exercise does, laughter apparently accomplishes the opposite.
strain.translationZh: 事实上，运动通过拉伸肌肉来强健肌肉，而笑显然起到相反的作用。
strain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

strain.sentenceEn: But most women today are coping with a lot of obligations, with few breaks, and feeling the strain .
strain.translationZh: 但如今大多数女性都背负着大量责任，几乎没有喘息之机，并感受着由此带来的压力。
strain.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
strain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

strain.sentenceEn: Moreover, even though humans have been upright for millions of years, our feet and back continue to struggle with bipedal posture and cannot easily withstand repeated strain imposed by oversize limbs.
strain.translationZh: 此外，尽管人类直立行走已有数百万年，但我们的双脚和背部仍在与双足行走的姿势作斗争，难以轻松承受因肢体过大而反复施加的压力。
strain.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
strain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

strain.sentenceEn: Nothing could persuade me to return to the kind of life Kelsey used to advocate and I once enjoyed: 12-hour working days, pressured deadlines, the fearful strain of office politics and the limitations of being a parent on "quality time".
strain.translationZh: 没有什么能说服我回到凯尔西曾经倡导、我也曾享受的那种生活：每天工作12小时，承受着紧迫的截止日期，办公室政治带来的可怕压力，以及作为父母只能拥有“优质时间”的局限。
strain.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
strain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

strive.sentenceEn: We are eliminating a stage, booking fewer performers and making additional cuts to reduce our costs, all while striving to keep the festival as vibrant as ever, as supportive of local artists and businesses, and as true to Wicker Park's unique spirit and reputation as festgoers have come to expect.
strive.translationZh: 我们正在通过取消一个舞台、减少表演嘉宾人数以及采取其他削减措施来降低成本。与此同时，我们仍将竭尽全力，确保音乐节一如既往地充满活力，继续支持当地艺术家和商家，并坚守参与者们所期待的柳条公园（Wicker Park）那独特的精神与名声。
strive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

strive.sentenceEn: Most of us strive for self-respect — to see ourselves in a positive light, to be proud of who we are.
strive.translationZh: 我们大多数人都在追求自尊——希望以积极的眼光看待自己，并为自己的身份感到自豪。
strive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

strive.sentenceEn: As the Chinese philosopher Chuang Tzu is reported to have said: "Happiness is the absence of striving for happiness."
strive.translationZh: 正如中国哲学家庄子所言：“幸福在于不刻意追求幸福。”
strive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第3句

strive.sentenceEn: The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways.
strive.translationZh: 最成功的君主制国家都在努力摒弃或隐藏其旧有的贵族做派。
strive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

strive.sentenceEn: It doesn't help that building a big, powerful dam has become a symbol of achievement for nations and people striving to assert themselves.
strive.translationZh: 更糟的是，修建一座宏伟的大坝已成为那些急于彰显自身实力的国家和民族的成就象征。
strive.paperLabel: 考研英语 1998 英语（未分卷）
strive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

surprising.sentenceEn: Such an encouraging result is not surprising .
surprising.translationZh: 这样令人鼓舞的结果并不意外。
surprising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

surprising.sentenceEn: Even more surprising is that more than half of "unretirees"—those who plan to work in retirement or went back to work after retiring—said they would be employed in their later years even if they had enough money to settle down, the survey showed.
surprising.translationZh: 更令人惊讶的是，超过一半的“未退休者”——那些计划退休后继续工作或退休后重返职场的人——表示，即使他们有足够的钱安享晚年，也仍会在晚年继续工作。
surprising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

surprising.sentenceEn: The readiness of the rats to befriend the social robot was surprising given its minimal design.
surprising.translationZh: 考虑到社交机器人极简的设计，老鼠们愿意与其交朋友的程度令人惊讶。
surprising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

surprising.sentenceEn: This isn't surprising , considering the basic mandatory high school curriculum leaves students with a poor understanding of the vast academic possibilities that await them in college.
surprising.translationZh: 这并不奇怪，因为高中的基础必修课程使学生对大学中等待他们的广阔学术可能性缺乏充分了解。
surprising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

surprising.sentenceEn: With the blurring of roles, and the fact that the home front lags well behind the workplace in making adjustments for working women, it's not surprising that women are more stressed at home.
surprising.translationZh: 由于角色界限变得模糊，再加上家庭领域在为职业女性做出调整方面远远落后于工作场所，女性在家中压力更大也就不足为奇了。
surprising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

surprising.sentenceEn: So it's not surprising that people are more stressed at home.
surprising.translationZh: 因此，人们在家中压力更大也就不足为奇了。
surprising.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

sustain.sentenceEn: A "town of culture" could be not just about the arts but about honouring a town's peculiarities—helping sustain its high street, supporting local facilities and above all celebrating its people.
sustain.translationZh: "文化之镇"不仅关乎艺术，还在于彰显小镇的独特魅力——助力维持商业街活力，支持本地设施建设，最重要的是颂扬当地民众。
sustain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

sustain.sentenceEn: Before each of their revelations, many thinkers at the time had sustained more ancient ways of thinking, including the geocentric view that the Earth was at the centre of our universe.
sustain.translationZh: 在他们各自的发现问世之前，当时的许多思想家一直秉持着更为古老的思维方式，其中包括地球是宇宙中心的地心说观点。
sustain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

sustain.sentenceEn: The most loyal customers would still get the product they favor, the idea goes, and they'd feel like they were helping sustain the quality of something they believe in.
sustain.translationZh: 其思路是，最忠实的客户仍能获得他们青睐的产品，并且会觉得自己在帮助维持他们所信赖的产品质量。
sustain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

sustain.sentenceEn: However, Allen believed that the unconscious mind generates as much action as the conscious mind, and while we may be able to sustain the illusion of control through the conscious mind alone, in reality we are continually faced with a question: "Why cannot I make myself do this or achieve that?"
sustain.translationZh: 然而，艾伦认为潜意识与显意识产生的行为同样多。尽管我们或许能仅凭显意识维持掌控的错觉，但实际上我们会不断面临一个问题："为什么我不能让自己做到这件事或实现那个目标？"
sustain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

sustain.sentenceEn: But because hard laughter is difficult to sustain , a good laugh is unlikely to have measurable benefits the way, say, walking or jogging does.
sustain.translationZh: 但由于开怀大笑难以持久，一场畅快的笑不太可能像散步或慢跑那样产生显著的益处。
sustain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

sustain.sentenceEn: All these activities can prevent the growth of important communication and thinking skills and make it difficult for kids to develop the kind of sustained concentration they will need for most jobs.
sustain.translationZh: 所有这些活动都会阻碍重要的沟通和思维能力的发展，并且使孩子们难以培养出大多数工作所需要的那种持续专注力。
sustain.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
sustain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第4句

systematic.sentenceEn: To find their sites, archaeologists today rely heavily on systematic survey methods and a variety of high-technology tools and techniques.
systematic.translationZh: 为了找到遗址，如今考古学家在很大程度上依赖系统的勘察方法以及各种高科技工具和技术。

systematic.sentenceEn: Contrary to the descriptions on record, no systematic evidence was found that levels of productivity were related to changes in lighting.
systematic.translationZh: 与记录中的描述相反，没有发现系统性证据表明生产率水平与照明变化有关。
systematic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

systematic.sentenceEn: Religious associations began, for example, in the desire to secure the favor of overruling powers and to ward off evil influences; family life in the desire to gratify appetites and secure family perpetuity; systematic labor, for the most part, because of enslavement to others, etc.
systematic.translationZh: 例如，宗教团体的起源是为了获得至高无上的神灵庇佑并抵御邪恶影响；家庭生活源于满足欲望和确保家族延续的愿望；系统性劳动在很大程度上则是因为受制于他人，等等。

systematic.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

systematic.sentenceEn: Therefore, it is important to study humans in all their richness and diversity in a calm and systematic manner, with the hope that the knowledge resulting from such studies can lead humans to a more harmonious way of living with themselves and with all other life forms on this planet Earth.
systematic.translationZh: 因此，以冷静系统的方式研究人类的丰富性和多样性至关重要，希望这些研究产生的知识能引导人类与自身以及地球上所有其他生命形式建立更和谐的共存方式。

systematic.sentenceEn: Social science is that branch of intellectual enquiry which seeks to study humans and their endeavors in the same reasoned, orderly, systematic , and dispassioned manner that natural scientists use for the study of natural phenomena.
systematic.translationZh: 社会科学是知识探索的一个分支，它致力于以自然科学家研究自然现象时所采用的那种理性、有序、系统且客观的方式，来研究人类及其活动。

systematic.sentenceEn: "Large numbers of physicians seem unconcerned with the pain their patients are needlessly and predictably suffering", to the extent that it constitutes " systematic patient abuse".
systematic.translationZh: “许多医生似乎对患者正在遭受的不必要且可预见的痛苦漠不关心”，这种情况已构成“系统性的患者虐待”。
